items.content: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced the company’s Q3 earnings on Tuesday, without initially mentioning former CEO Jensen Huang or the details of his departure, or possible attempt at a return. On the earnings call accompanying the release, board chair Harvey Jones kicked things off by saying the board “does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO,” and that “we will not be addressing or taking questions on today’s call regarding the circumstances of Jensen’s resignation and the ongoing investigation,” before Kress started with her comments on the results.RelatedNvidia says it will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEOTech leaders are convinced that Jensen Huang’s exit was a plot against himAs it predicted in the last financial update, Nvidia is now on the list of companies that have pulled in over $100 billion in a single quarter, with revenues of $115.8 billion, up 103 percent from the same period last year and higher than its expectation of $108 billion. This quarter’s figures include data center revenues of $107.6 billion, which were up 110 percent, and edge computing (which includes the consumer gaming PC business and devices like the new RTX Spark laptops) revenue of $8.2 billion, up 42 percent.The company reported $65.3 billion in profit, a new record.“Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.”In the fourth quarter, Nvidia expects revenues of $130 billion.Update, November 17th: Added comments from Nvidia’s earnings call.

items.titleZh: 英伟达Q3财报达标，却未提及黄仁勋那档子事
items.descriptionZh: 英伟达临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯于周二公布了公司第三季度财报，但最初并未提及前CEO黄仁勋或其离职细节，也未提及他可能尝试回归一事。在随财报发布的业绩电话会议上，董事会主席哈维·琼斯首先表示，董事会“不打算让黄仁勋重新担任CEO”，并且“我们不会在今天的电话会议上就黄仁勋辞职的相关情况以及正在进行的调查作出回应或接受提问”，随后克雷斯开始就业绩发表评论。相关报道：英伟达表示不会让黄仁勋重新担任CEO；科技界领袖坚信黄仁勋的离职是针对他的阴谋。正如上次财务更新中所预测的那样，英伟达如今已跻身单季度营收超过1000亿美元的公司之列，营收达到1158亿美元，同比增长103%，高于其1080亿美元的预期。本季度数据包括数据中心营收1076亿美元，同比增长110%；边缘计算（包括消费级游戏PC业务以及新款RTX Spark笔记本电脑等设备）营收82亿美元，同比增长42%。公司报告利润为653亿美元，创下新纪录。“我们的势头是真实的。英伟达是一家卓越的技术领导者，这得益于我们员工的不懈创新，”英伟达临时CEO、执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯表示。“Vera Rubin开局强劲，我们的路线图正在按计划推进，我们的雄心从未如此之大。”英伟达预计第四季度营收为1300亿美元。更新，11月17日：补充了英伟达财报电话会议上的评论。

items.titleZh: 面向异构集成良率的缺陷感知芯粒匹配（ASU, Ampere）
items.descriptionZh:
亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）与Ampere Computing的研究人员发表了题为《DT-MATCH: Defect- and Topology-Aware Chiplet Matching for Yield Optimization in Heterogeneous Integration》的论文，研究缺陷与拓扑感知的芯粒匹配方法，用于提升异构集成良率。该工作由Semiconductor Engineering报道。

背景方面，异构集成（HI）和先进封装使基于芯粒（chiplet）的SoC设计成为可能，可以把多个裸片通过高密度die-to-die（D2D）互连集成在一个封装内，从而突破单芯片面积、工艺和成本限制。但这也带来新的良率挑战：制造缺陷会影响单个芯粒或D2D链路的可用性，复杂的D2D互连约束又要求参与集成的芯粒在拓扑和链路层面相互匹配。尤其是lane级缺陷、有限的互连资源或冗余能力等问题，可能导致原本可用的芯粒组合无法形成合格系统，从而拉低封装级良率并增加成本。

从论文标题和公开摘要看，DT-MATCH的核心思路是把芯粒匹配从传统的“已知合格裸片（KGD）筛选”推进到“缺陷与拓扑感知的组合优化”。其技术原理大致是：在异构集成组装前，利用各芯粒的测试信息、缺陷分布以及D2D互连拓扑约束，对芯粒进行优化配对和映射，使缺陷链路或受限拓扑能够通过合理的芯粒组合被规避或补偿，而不是简单丢弃有局部缺陷的芯粒。创新点在于同时考虑制造缺陷和D2D拓扑约束，特别是lane级缺陷对互连可用性的影响，将芯粒匹配建模为面向良率优化的组合问题。

性能参数和对比数据方面，目前公开的新闻摘要仅给出论文标题、研究机构和问题背景，未披露具体良率提升幅度、算法复杂度、对比基线、测试芯片结果或成本收益等量化数据，因此无法从该新闻中给出具体性能数字。后续需要查看论文全文才能确认DT-MATCH相对传统KGD筛选或缺陷无感知匹配方法在封装良率、D2D链路可用率、匹配成功率和测试成本等指标上的实际改进。

技术影响和应用场景上，该方法面向chiplet异构集成和先进封装的设计—制造协同，可用于基于芯粒的SoC、云原生CPU、HPC/AI加速器以及多裸片封装产品。Ampere Computing的参与也说明该问题与数据中心CPU的芯粒化设计密切相关。若方法有效，DT-MATCH有望减少因局部缺陷导致的整组报废，提高先进封装产线的有效良率，并降低高性能芯片的分摊成本。总体而言，该研究提出了从“筛选合格芯粒”转向“优化匹配可用芯粒组合”的思路，但具体效果仍需论文完整数据验证。

items.title: Nvidia claims its Vera CPU can gain up to 39% performance boost via software optimization at SC26 — architectural fine-tuning is needed to fully unleash custom Olympus cores
items.description: Nvidia's Vera CPU, powered by its custom Olympus Arm cores, already offers strong performance with unoptimized code, but at SC26, the company demonstrated that further software optimizations can improve performance by nearly 39% with certain workloads.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's Vera CPU, designed as both a standalone data-center part and a host for Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 servers, offers impressive performance thanks to substantially higher execution resources per core than its predecessor, Grace. However, Nvidia admits at Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) that existing software cannot always take full advantage of Vera's resources without adaptation for the architecture.The company shared that architecture-specific software optimizations can boost Vera's performance by nearly 39% in certain computationally intensive workloads. But despite offering unbeatable single-thread performance, the CPU is not positioned for general-purpose workloads.Get the Tom's Hardware App (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Get the full Tom's Hardware experience on your device with our brand-new app. Bookmark articles, use our smart search feature, personalize your feed, and get push notifications so you never miss a beat.Download now on Apple App StoreDownload now on the Google Play StoreUnlike Grace, which relies on off-the-shelf Neoverse V2 CPU cores developed by Arm, Vera uses Nvidia's proprietary Olympus cores specifically designed to maximize per-core performance as well as to ensure high aggregate throughput. To that end, Nvidia equipped Olympus with a wide front end that features a 10-wide decoder, a neural branch predictor, a deep out-of-order execution engine, six vector execution units, four load pipelines, two store pipelines, all backed with large private caches and advanced prefetch mechanisms.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Nvidia)In fact, Nvidia deliberately opted for 88 high-performance general-purpose cores with support for its proprietary spatial multithreading technology (176 threads in total) rather than maximizing the number of cores per socket, as the maximum possible single-thread performance was one of the key design goals for Vera."CPU design is really just a game of trade-offs," said Hannah Coutand, who leads Vera CPU marketing at Nvidia, in an interview with Tom's Hardware Premium. "You could maximize for a lot of cores, but literally when you maximize the die for lots of cores, you do not actually have space to maximize for IPC, like instructions per clock." You may like Benchmarking Nvidia’s Vera CPU for the data center — standalone Vera tested against Granite Rapids-AP and EPYC Turin Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down 88-core Vera CPU Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment Although Nvidia primarily positions Vera as a CPU for agentic AI and other AI-related workloads, the company originally conceived its Olympus microarchitecture with data processing applications in mind. As it turned out, the key attributes of Vera — high per-core performance, high memory bandwidth, and low memory access latency — are precisely what agentic AI workloads need as well, according to Coutand."We are very clear in our strategy with Vera and our positioning with Vera that it is not a general-purpose CPU," Coutand said. " If you want a web server for your cloud data center, there are probably other choices that are better suited for that than Vera. [Vera is made for] workloads […] that require that high per-core speed, high memory bandwidth, low latency. […] It has great fungibility for lots of workloads as long as those workloads value the things that Vera is good for."Software optimizations make good things betterTo assess the computational capabilities of Nvidia's custom Olympus microarchitecture and its advantages over Neoverse V2, Nvidia's researchers used a double-precision general matrix multiplication (DGEMM) workload based on an assembly kernel from OpenBLAS, an open-source linear algebra library. While OpenBLAS features a kernel tailored for the Arm Neoverse V2 cores that power Nvidia's Grace processor, it lacks one specifically designed for Olympus.To examine the efficiency of the two microarchitectures, the researchers used a standalone benchmark called miniKernelGEMM with a 128 × 128 matrix multiplication problem that fits into the L1 cache of both processors. (Image credit: Nvidia)The Grace CPU achieved 4.51 instructions per clock (IPC) and 13.03 FP64 operations per cycle with the Neoverse V2 kernel, whereas Vera executed 5.43 instructions per clock and 15.69 FP64 operations per cycle with the very same code, an improvement of approximately 20%. What to read next Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips SpaceXAI will deploy standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs for Grok's agentic workloads OpenAI’s Jalapeño ASICs are deployed alongside AMD EPYC ‘Turin’ CPUs as hosts, not Nvidia's Vera However, when the researchers used a kernel specifically optimized for Olympus, Vera’s performance increased to 7.53 instructions per clock and 21.75 FP64 operations per cycle. As a result, Vera outperformed its predecessor by nearly 67% on a per-core, per-clock basis in this particular workload.Grace's Neoverse V2 microarchitecture has four 128-bit SIMD pipelines that can perform a total of 16 FP64 operations per clock, whereas Nvidia's Olympus has six such pipelines that can execute up to 24 FP64 operations per cycle, a 50% improvement.But where the Neoverse V2-optimized kernel uses 81.4% of Grace's peak FP64 throughput, it uses only about 66.5% of Vera's computational capabilities. With changes to matrix tile organization, register allocation, and instruction scheduling that better suit the Olympus microarchitecture, the researchers managed to utilize 90.6% of its peak FP64 throughput, according to Nvidia's tutorial published at SC26. (Image credit: Nvidia)While software developed and optimized for existing Arm-based data center processors can still benefit from the capabilities of Nvidia's Olympus cores without any specific optimizations, the company's SC26 benchmark results demonstrate that at least some applications will need to be fine-tuned for the new microarchitecture to take full advantage of its execution resources. Of course, it remains to be seen how much performance can be gained through Olympus-specific optimizations in workloads other than matrix multiplication.As Nvidia expands beyond CPUs that primarily serve as companions to its data center GPUs and chases the standalone server CPU market, the company will have to ensure that performance-critical software takes advantage of the architectural peculiarities of its processors, much like Intel and AMD have done for decades.But the company is already deeply experienced with partner and ecosystem development for platforms like CUDA, so as Vera is more widely adopted, that experience could prove useful in spurring optimizations for these CPUs going forward.

items.titleZh: Nvidia声称其Vera CPU在SC26上通过软件优化可获得最高39%的性能提升——需要架构微调才能充分释放定制Olympus核心的潜力
items.descriptionZh:
英伟达在Supercomputing 2026（SC26）上披露了其Vera CPU的更多技术细节。Vera既是独立的数据中心CPU，也可作为英伟达Vera Rubin NVL72服务器的宿主处理器。与上一代Grace采用Arm现成的Neoverse V2核心不同，Vera使用英伟达自研的Olympus微架构核心，设计目标是最大化单核性能并保证高总体吞吐量。Olympus配备10宽解码器、神经分支预测器、深度乱序执行引擎、6个向量执行单元、4条加载流水线和2条存储流水线，并配有大容量私有缓存和高级预取机制。Vera采用88个高性能通用核心，支持英伟达专有的空间多线程技术，共176线程；英伟达刻意没有追求更多核心数量，而是优先保证单线程性能。Vera CPU营销负责人Hannah Coutand表示，CPU设计本质上是权衡取舍，最大化核心数会挤占提升IPC（每时钟指令数）的空间。

性能方面，英伟达使用基于OpenBLAS汇编内核的双精度通用矩阵乘法（DGEMM）负载，以及128×128矩阵乘法miniKernelGEMM基准（可放入两颗处理器的L1缓存）对比Grace和Vera。使用现有Neoverse V2内核时，Grace达到4.51 IPC和每周期13.03次FP64运算，Vera达到5.43 IPC和每周期15.69次FP64运算，提升约20%。但使用针对Olympus优化的内核后，Vera提升至7.53 IPC和每周期21.75次FP64运算，单核单时钟性能比Grace提升近67%。硬件上，Grace的Neoverse V2有4条128位SIMD流水线，每周期最多执行16次FP64运算；Olympus有6条，每周期最多24次，提升50%。不过，Neoverse V2优化内核只能利用Vera约66.5%的峰值FP64吞吐量，而能利用Grace峰值的81.4%；通过调整矩阵分块、寄存器分配和指令调度，英伟达将Vera的峰值利用率提升至90.6%。英伟达称，针对架构的软件优化在某些计算密集型负载中可将Vera性能提升近39%。

影响与应用场景方面，Vera并非通用CPU。Coutand明确表示，如果云数据中心需要Web服务器，Vera可能不是最佳选择；Vera面向需要高单核速度、高内存带宽和低延迟的负载，例如智能体AI（agentic AI）和数据处理。Olympus最初就是为数据处理应用构思的，而这些特性恰好也是智能体AI所需。现有为Arm数据中心处理器开发的软件无需专门优化也能从Olympus核心受益，但SC26的基准表明，至少部分应用需要针对新微架构调优才能充分利用其执行资源。随着英伟达从数据中心GPU的配套CPU扩展到独立服务器CPU市场，确保性能关键软件适配其架构特性将至关重要，正如英特尔和AMD数十年来所做的那样。英伟达在CUDA等平台的合作伙伴和生态建设方面经验深厚，随着Vera更广泛采用，这种经验可能有助于推动软件优化。

items.content: The Justice and Commerce Departments said that they are investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center company intertwined with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, after reporting suggested an investigation had been halted last year.“While we don’t typically comment on ongoing investigations, it is in the public interest to provide the facts and address inaccurate information circulating in public reporting,” the departments said in a statement issued Monday evening. The departments acknowledged there’s been “significant public attention” on Megaspeed.Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week after reports he had an affair with former Megaspeed executive and alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, who Megaspeed says left the company in August 2025. The scandal has raised questions about national security, and sparked scrutiny of Nvidia’s handling of exports of its chips to China and Megaspeed’s possible role in moving along Nvidia’s chips.RelatedSenator slams commerce secretary for flow of Nvidia AI chips to ChinaThe Nvidia scandal isn’t slowing downEarlier this month, the New York Times reported that a Commerce Department investigation into Megaspeed “came to a sudden halt” late last year after its investigators received an email from Nvidia’s general counsel, claiming Commerce Department official Jeffrey Kessler gave Nvidia permission to reach out. The case was then “quickly” handed over to the DOJ, according to the Times.The announcement today says the DOJ took the “lead role” in the investigation last year:After identifying suspicious activity through proactive monitoring of potential sensitive semiconductor diversion, the Department of Commerce initiated an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations. In May 2025, Department of Commerce investigators requested records from Nvidia concerning direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed. In June 2025, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its “no sell” list. Based on the Department of Commerce’s investigation, agents from the Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, in conjunction with Singaporean law enforcement officials, conducted an on-site, in-person, end-use check at Megaspeed in June 2025 and interviewed CEO Alice Huang.Following this enforcement action, the Department of Justice took the lead role in the criminal investigation of Megaspeed.The statement doesn’t go into detail about the current status of the case, but it says the DOJ and Commerce Department “will bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred.”

items.titleZh: 美国司法部称正在调查Megaspeed
items.descriptionZh:
美国司法部与商务部周一晚间发表声明称，正在调查新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed，并回应此前媒体报道称相关调查去年已被叫停。两部门表示，通常不对正在进行的调查置评，但出于公共利益有必要提供事实、纠正公共报道中的不准确信息，并承认Megaspeed案受到“显著公众关注”。该案与英伟达CEO黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）辞职事件交织：报道称，黄仁勋上周辞去英伟达CEO职务，此前有媒体报道他与Megaspeed前高管Alice Huang有婚外情，后者被指为中国间谍；Megaspeed称Alice Huang已于2025年8月离开公司。该丑闻引发国家安全担忧，并促使外界审视英伟达对华芯片出口的处理，以及Megaspeed可能在转运英伟达芯片中扮演的角色。相关报道还提到，有参议员抨击商务部长在英伟达AI芯片流向中国问题上的处理，且该丑闻并未降温。

《纽约时报》本月初报道称，商务部对Megaspeed的调查在去年底“突然停止”，原因是调查人员收到英伟达总法律顾问的邮件，称商务部官员Jeffrey Kessler允许英伟达联系；案件随后“迅速”移交给司法部。两部门最新声明则称，司法部去年已在调查中发挥“主导作用”。声明给出的时间线是：商务部通过对潜在敏感半导体转移的主动监控发现可疑活动，于2024年对Megaspeed启动潜在出口管制违规调查；2025年5月，商务部调查人员要求英伟达提供与Megaspeed直接或间接销售有关的记录；2025年6月，英伟达将Megaspeed列入“禁止销售”名单；同月，商务部工业与安全局（BIS）人员与新加坡执法官员在Megaspeed进行现场、面对面的最终用途检查，并采访了CEO Alice Huang。此后，司法部接管了对Megaspeed的刑事调查主导权。

本案涉及的“核心技术”并非芯片性能创新，而是敏感半导体出口管制与供应链追踪机制：通过主动监控发现可疑转移、调取企业销售记录、将相关实体列入禁售名单、开展最终用途核查，并在发现违规线索后转入刑事调查。其影响主要集中在AI芯片供应链合规、第三国数据中心可能充当转运节点的风险，以及国家安全审查对英伟达出口管理和新加坡数据中心角色的审视。声明未披露案件当前具体进展，也未提供任何芯片性能参数或对比数据，但明确表示司法部和商务部将“依法追究Megaspeed任何可能存在的犯罪行为到底”。

items.content: Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week, would be willing to return as CEO if the company’s board of directors wanted it, he said in a statement reported on by The Wall Street Journal.“Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” Huang said. “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”Huang resigned on Thursday following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and a direct report. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO.“I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life,” Huang said. “I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.”More than 193,000 people, including CEOs like Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, have signed a letter to “bring Jensen back.” President Trump has also been supportive of Huang returning as CEO, saying yesterday that it “certainly isn’t a bad idea.” (Trump had earlier tossed out former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a potential replacement.) On Monday, Nvidia’s board reportedly was “not considering” having Huang return, and today, CNN reported that the board is “not considering reinstating Huang.”Nvidia didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.Here is Huang’s full statement:Over the past week, I’ve been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I’ve never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me.I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. NVIDIA has been my life’s work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible. I love our country, and I love NVIDIA.I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life. I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.Thank you again to everyone who has shared their good wishes. I am profoundly humbled by your support. To my family: I love you, and I will spend the rest of my life being worthy of yours.JensenUpdate, November 17th: CNN reports that Nvidia’s board is not considering reinstating Huang.

items.descriptionZh:
美国众议院外交事务委员会、情报委员会和中国选择委员会已确认，前英伟达CEO黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）将于12月1日出席国会听证，英伟达律师蒂姆·泰特（Tim Teter）将于12月2日随后作证。CNBC报道称，这三个小组委员会的主席在数日猜测后公布了上述安排。此前，国会于11月9日致函要求黄仁勋出席，而就在一天前，他承认与Alice Huang存在婚外情；Alice Huang被指为中国间谍。随后有消息称，如果黄仁勋不在11月18日前回应，国会可能发出传票。随着12月作证安排确认，传票已不再需要。

众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特（Brian Mast）、中国选择委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔（John Moolenaar）和情报委员会主席里克·克劳福德（Rick Crawford）在声明中表示，期待听取黄仁勋和泰特在“潜在国家安全漏洞中所扮演角色”的说明，并强调“美国人民需要答案”。他们指出，允许中国国家行为者获取英伟达所制造的先进AI芯片将是“危险的”。

报道称，Alice Huang曾是Megaspeed公司高管，而Megaspeed在黄仁勋担任英伟达CEO期间是英伟达客户。由于担心该公司违反美国出口法律、参与向中国走私AI芯片，Megaspeed后来被列入英伟达的禁售名单。其子公司Speedmatrix被指控进口英伟达芯片后再出口至中国。目前，针对Megaspeed的刑事调查已经启动，以厘清涉及AI公司和芯片运输的复杂网络。

从技术层面看，这一事件的核心并非英伟达芯片的架构创新或性能参数，而是先进AI芯片的出口管制与合规风险。先进AI加速芯片是训练和部署大模型的关键硬件，美国出口限制旨在防止此类算力被中国国家行为者获取。Megaspeed及其子公司被指通过进口后再出口的方式规避管制，形成芯片走私链条，因而触发国会和刑事调查。原文未披露具体芯片型号、性能指标或对比数据。

事件背景是，黄仁勋在承认与Alice Huang的婚外情后辞去英伟达CEO职务；此后又有报道称他至少还与一名英伟达员工存在婚外情。尽管如此，要求黄仁勋回归英伟达最高职位的呼声仍在增加。国会听证将聚焦其任职期间与Megaspeed的关系、英伟达出口合规机制，以及先进AI芯片可能经由客户和子公司流向中国的国家安全影响。该事件也凸显AI芯片出口管制在执行层面的挑战：企业客户审查、最终用途追踪和跨国转口贸易监管，正成为AI算力供应链安全的重要环节。

英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋辞职后，事件迅速从公司治理危机扩展为涉及国家安全、出口管制和台湾公众情绪的复杂风波。辞职背景是黄仁勋承认与一名女子有婚外情，而该女子被指为中国政府间谍；美国随后宣布对这名女子所在公司Megaspeed展开刑事调查，担心该公司可能协助规避与英伟达AI芯片相关的出口管制。尽管存在这些争议，台湾中央社报道称，台北101大楼在11月16日晚间投射出“Taiwan ♡ Jensen”“Family ♡ Friendship”“Thrive Together”等支持信息。报道指出，黄仁勋在台湾具有近乎名人般的知名度，台湾科技业界人士还集资资助了这次灯光秀，一名科技从业者称活动意在“把黄仁勋带回来”，表达台湾对他的关心。这反映出黄仁勋在台湾科技产业中的象征性影响力，以及公众对其处境的同情。

随后有报道称，黄仁勋可能在递交辞呈数日后谋划重返英伟达最高职位。SpaceX CEO埃隆·马斯克和Epic Games CEO蒂姆·斯威尼已公开支持其回归，要求英伟达董事会让黄仁勋复职的呼声还延伸到白宫，美国总统特朗普也呼吁恢复其职位。特朗普表示，黄仁勋并未将国家安全置于风险之中。不过，围绕其情人是否为中国间谍、以及黄仁勋对此知情程度的不确定性仍然存在。知情人士对CNBC表示，英伟达董事会并未认真考虑让黄仁勋复职，公司当前重点是调查其行为以及国家安全相关问题，同时还会考虑有关黄仁勋与一名英伟达高管存在另一段婚外情的报道。公司治理因此进入高度不确定阶段：一边是政治人物和行业领袖的复职呼声，另一边是董事会调查与国家安全审查。

目前，英伟达前CFO科莱特·克雷斯担任临时CEO。她上任不久便面临首次重大考验——公司自丑闻以来的首场财报电话会于11月17日举行。原文未披露任何AI芯片性能参数、产品对比数据或具体技术原理，事件核心并非芯片架构创新，而是英伟达领导层更替、出口合规与国家安全审查对公司声誉和投资者信心的冲击。英伟达AI芯片广泛应用于数据中心训练和推理等场景，且长期处于美国对华出口管制敏感地带，因此Megaspeed调查及黄仁勋事件可能影响市场对英伟达合规风险和供应链稳定性的判断。整体来看，这一事件已从高管个人丑闻演变为牵动台湾舆论、美国政治、公司董事会和出口管制执法的多层面危机，英伟达短期内的治理稳定性和财报沟通将成为外界关注焦点。

items.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
items.description: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance […]
items.content: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing. He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory. “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries, he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. At Argonne National Laboratory, Buck said, an agent built with the toolkit took a single prompt, planned and tested hypotheses, chose which simulations to run and identified two new binding sites. “You own your data. You own the model,” Buck said. Buck highlighted other agents already in use: GROMACS: An agent from KTH Royal Institute of Technology repairs broken GROMACS setups on its own. In one overnight run on a single DGX Spark, it fixed 81% of test cases. SETI Institute: At the Allen Telescope Array, an agent took a one-line prompt to plot a methanol line. Buck explained that it then retuned for Doppler shift on its own [NGC 869 vs. 896, check slide]. Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens. CPUs for the Agent Loop Agents lean on CPUs to run tool calls between model steps, Buck explained. “That’s exactly what agents need,” he said. “They need a CPU that can run, evaluate, run the tool, perform the operations, gather the results.” DKRZ, the German Climate Computing Center, has selected Vera CPUs for its HLRE-5 supercomputer, expected in early 2028. Buck said it joins Vera systems already announced at Texas Advanced Computing Center. A New GPU for Science Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the Vera Rubin platform, built for science, engineering, analytics and AI, Buck said. It supports precisions from FP64 to FP4, adds sparse-data acceleration and connects over seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink. With more than 50,000 CUDA cores, it has about three times as many as Hopper, Buck said. It is expected in 2028. Quantum Error Correction Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold. The work is being added to CUDA-Q. NVIDIA, IBM and Fermilab announced plans today for a quantum computing co-design platform to support error-correction and applications research. NVIDIA and IBM are pairing NVIDIA DGX B200 systems with IBM quantum computers, including those powered by IBM Quantum Nighthawk. Buck also introduced a new breakthrough for quantum decoding. The goal, Buck explained, is to cut decoding latency from about 300 microseconds to 10. A new CUDA-Q decoding algorithm, TCBP-JOBS, cuts error-correction research computation from 12 weeks to 45 minutes, he said. Networking Buck also showed one of the first deployments of NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics switches, at Lambda. He said they are 15x more reliable on bit errors and link flaps. See notice regarding software product information.

items.titleZh: 伊恩·巴克为NVIDIA在SC26的周活动揭幕，科学迈入智能体时代
items.descriptionZh:
在芝加哥举行的SC26超算大会上，NVIDIA超大规模与高性能计算副总裁Ian Buck在特别演讲中发布了一系列面向科学发现的AI智能体工具、Nemotron for Science开放模型、Rubin HPC GPU、扩展的Vera CPU平台，以及NVIDIA与IBM、费米国家加速器实验室在量子计算领域的新合作。Buck回顾了20年前在SC06教程上首次公开讲解CUDA，指出NVIDIA目前已有1000多个CUDA-X库。他表示，计算前沿和新的科学计算栈仍以模拟为基础，但将与AI、量子计算以及智能体协同工作。

在AI智能体方面，Buck称智能体正在改变研究人员与超算、设备和仪器交互以及开展研究的方式。Nemotron for Science将Nemotron 3.5 Super VL开放模型与新的开放化学数据集、面向生命科学和化学的后训练配方相结合，可在DGX Spark、工作站或研究人员自有超算上本地运行，强调“数据归用户所有、模型归用户所有”。在阿贡国家实验室，基于该工具包构建的智能体接收单条提示后，自主规划并检验假设、选择要运行的模拟，并识别出两个新的结合位点。其他案例包括：瑞典皇家理工学院的GROMACS智能体可自行修复损坏的GROMACS配置，在单台DGX Spark上夜间运行修复了81%的测试案例；SETI研究所艾伦望远镜阵列的智能体根据一行提示绘制甲醇谱线，并自行重新调整多普勒频移；NVIDIA的Nsight AI移植智能体将天气预报与研究模型WRF中的一个例程移植到GPU，使用约1.5亿token实现5倍以上加速。

在硬件方面，Buck解释智能体在模型步骤之间执行工具调用依赖CPU，因此需要能够运行、评估、调用工具、执行操作并收集结果的CPU。德国气候计算中心DKRZ已选择Vera CPU用于其预计2028年初上线的HLRE-5超算，加入此前已宣布的得克萨斯高级计算中心等Vera系统。Rubin HPC是Vera Rubin平台中面向科学、工程、分析和AI的新GPU，支持从FP64到FP4的精度，增加稀疏数据加速，采用第七代NVLink，拥有超过5万个CUDA核心，约为Hopper的三倍，预计2028年推出。

量子计算方面，Buck称在Jülich JUPITER超算上的模拟显示，一种名为“魔法态培养”的技术可将一个逻辑步骤所需的操作减少十倍，该工作正被加入CUDA-Q。NVIDIA、IBM和费米实验室宣布计划共建量子计算协同设计平台，支持纠错与应用研究；NVIDIA DGX B200系统将与IBM量子计算机配对，包括由IBM Quantum Nighthawk驱动的系统。Buck还介绍了量子解码的新突破：目标是将解码延迟从约300微秒降至10微秒；新的CUDA-Q解码算法TCBP-JOBS可将纠错研究计算从12周缩短至45分钟。网络方面，NVIDIA Photonics共封装光学交换机在Lambda首批部署，在位错误和链路闪断方面的可靠性提升15倍。

items.title: Nvidia warns customers of new US rule that could expose them to lawsuits for serving Chinese clients
items.description: This warning comes amid Jensen Huang's scandal, a new rule from the U.S. Department of Commerce, and a pending bill in the Senate.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter CNBC reports that Nvidia has started warning its customers that impending legislation to clamp down on countries accessing AI GPUs remotely via data center rentals could put them in trouble with U.S. authorities. Chinese tech companies could take advantage of the performance of American AI hardware through a loophole in U.S. regulations. Instead of importing Nvidia chips, which are under export controls, they instead look to data centers located abroad and export their data instead. This is what Chinese AI lab Moonshot is apparently trying in Europe, which is why the U.S. Department of Commerce, through the Bureau of Industry and Security [PDF], released an interim final rule closing this loophole.According to the report, Nvidia has been messaging chip buyers to warn that RASA could expose both Nvidia and chip buyers to legal risk.The U.S. House of Representatives has already passed a bill called the Remote Access Security Act (RASA) that addressed this specific loophole, but it’s been in limbo in the Senate for over ten months now. It remains unclear if the Jensen Huang affair and suspected espionage scandal will help speed up its approval, but scheduling could be tight with only about 31 calendar days remaining before the Senate's adjournment. But even before any of these regulations are approved and published, the company is already taking steps to protect its customers and has started requiring partners that 51% of their services should go to non-Chinese clients. It has also required its partners to join Nvidia’s Fleet Intelligence tracking system if they want to retain their official partner statusLatest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It’s unclear if these changes have been planned over time or were a reaction to the renewed scrutiny that Nvidia is facing. But even though Jensen Huang is now out of the company, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that it’s unclear if the former Nvidia CEO was aware of the alleged smuggling operations and instead laid the blame on the entire company. Nvidia itself has taken steps to improve its security and export control teams by establishing an oversight committee that will be in charge of its “national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risk management,” and would work with third-party experts in law, national security, and trade compliance.These measures would further tighten the noose around China’s AI GPUs. Even though it has several domestic chip makers, many AI operators still prefer Nvidia chips for their performance and reliability. There have even been allegations that Alibaba and ByteDance, some of China’s biggest tech companies, prefer training their LLMs in Southeast Asia to bypass bans and restrictions. So, if the U.S. finally shuts down this loophole, we can expect these companies to scramble and find a replacement for the Nvidia GPUs they could access right now. items.titleZh: 英伟达警告客户：美国新规或致其因服务中国客户而面临诉讼
items.descriptionZh:
CNBC报道称，英伟达已开始向客户发出警告：美国正在推进的远程访问安全法案（Remote Access Security Act，RASA）可能让通过海外数据中心远程租用AI GPU的国家和企业面临美国法律风险，也可能使英伟达及芯片买家同时暴露于合规风险。该问题的背景是，美国出口管制主要限制英伟达AI芯片的对华出口，但中国科技公司可以通过监管漏洞，不直接进口受管制芯片，而是在境外数据中心远程调用美国AI硬件并回传数据，从而获得接近进口芯片的算力。报道称，中国AI实验室Moonshot正试图在欧洲采用这种方式。为此，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）已发布临时最终规则，着手关闭这一远程访问漏洞；美国众议院也已通过RASA，但该法案在参议院搁置超过10个月，距离参议院休会仅剩约31个日历日，能否借近期争议加速通过仍不确定。

从技术监管原理看，这一漏洞的核心在于出口管制此前主要针对实体芯片跨境流动，而云计算和远程算力服务使境外用户无需获得硬件即可使用受控AI GPU，形成“硬件不出境、算力跨境”的监管空白。RASA和BIS规则试图把远程访问AI服务器、GPU云服务纳入类似出口管制的合规框架。报道未披露具体算力、带宽或能效对比参数，但指出许多中国AI运营者仍因性能和可靠性优势偏好英伟达芯片；即使中国已有本土芯片厂商，英伟达GPU在AI训练等场景中仍具吸引力。还有指控称，阿里巴巴和字节跳动等中国大型科技公司偏好在中国以外、尤其是东南亚训练大语言模型，以绕过禁令和限制。

在立法尚未最终完成前，英伟达已在客户合规层面采取措施：要求合作伙伴至少51%的服务面向非中国客户，并要求合作伙伴加入英伟达的Fleet Intelligence追踪系统，才能保留官方合作伙伴身份。公司还成立了监督委员会，负责其“国家安全政策、出口管制合规和全球贸易风险管理”，并与法律、国家安全和贸易合规领域的第三方专家合作。报道还提到围绕黄仁勋的争议及疑似走私/间谍风波可能影响立法节奏，并称美国财长斯科特·贝森特表示尚不清楚黄仁勋是否知晓相关涉嫌走私操作，而将责任归于公司整体。

总体看，若美国最终堵住远程访问漏洞，中国AI企业通过境外数据中心调用英伟达GPU的路径将明显收窄，相关公司可能被迫加快寻找国产或其他替代算力，并调整大模型训练地点和云服务架构。这一规则的影响不仅在于芯片硬件出口，更在于把AI算力服务、云租赁和远程访问纳入出口管制与合规追踪范围，进一步收紧中国获取高端AI GPU的渠道。

items.title: US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal
items.description: The Justice and Commerce Departments have announced an investigation into Megaspeed over concerns that it may have been involved in the illegal export of Nvidia's AI hardware. The company was previously run by the woman officials have accused of being a Chinese spy while having an affair with Jensen Huang while he was Nvidia CEO.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A criminal investigation into Megaspeed has been confirmed by the United States Justice and Commerce Departments, with a joint statement saying that they will “bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred.” Authorities believe that Megaspeed is one of a raft of companies that may have circumvented export rules designed to limit the sale of advanced AI chips, like those built by Nvidia, to approved companies and countries. The company is at the heart of the recent Jensen Huang scandal, which saw him resign from the company last week.Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedMegaspeed was added to Nvidia's no-sell list in June 2025, the statement reveals, but a New York Times report claims that a Malaysian Megaspeed subsidiary continued to receive large shipments of Nvidia chips for a full eight months after that date. It's believed that Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell and H200 chips were shipped to Speedmatrix, either via third parties or directly from Nvidia itself, before being handed off to China. Nvidia has argued that it was given Commerce Department permission to ship the components to Megaspeed. Notably, Nvidia continues to list Megaspeed as a cloud partner.The new criminal investigation follows a Commerce Department investigation into Megaspeed that first kicked off in 2024 over possible export violations. By May 2025, it had requested Nvidia's data relating to sales it made to Megaspeed, and by June, officials visited Megaspeed and even interviewed Alice Huang, the now-former executive who is allegedly a Chinese spy. Ms. Huang is also the woman that then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with before resigning his position earlier this month. Following that visit, the Justice Department took the lead in the investigation into Megaspeed.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Joint Statement from Department of Commerce and Department of Justice on Megaspeed Investigation. https://t.co/aAdtN9aDfFNovember 17, 2026Megaspeed has long been accused of being a front for an AI component smuggling operation. In October 2025, an investigation claimed that it had helped move around $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips into China by importing them and then re-exporting them to the country. Megaspeed says that it complies with all laws and that the woman at the center of the affair scandal, Ms. Huang, is no longer at the company. The Chinese government has also dismissed claims that she was a state spy.The joint Commerce and Justice Departments' statement pointed to its strong track record when prosecuting chip smugglers to date. 17 defendants across a total of six investigations have been charged so far, with more likely to follow. A Californian man was recently arrested after being accused of smuggling more than $300 million worth of export-restricted Nvidia chips to China. He now faces up to 20 years in prison. items.titleZh: 美国政府证实对处于黄仁勋丑闻核心的新加坡公司展开刑事调查
items.descriptionZh:
美国商务部与司法部已确认对Megaspeed展开刑事调查，并在联合声明中表示，将“动用法律的全部力量”追究该公司可能存在的犯罪行为。执法部门认为，Megaspeed是涉嫌规避美国先进AI芯片出口管制的公司之一。相关管制要求英伟达等厂商的高端AI芯片只能出售给获批企业和国家。Megaspeed同时处于黄仁勋丑闻的中心：文章称，时任英伟达CEO黄仁勋因与该公司前高管Alice Huang的婚外情曝光而辞职；Alice Huang还被指为中国间谍，但中国政府否认这一说法，Megaspeed也表示她已离开公司，并称公司遵守所有法律。

案件时间线显示，美国商务部早在2024年就因潜在出口违规对Megaspeed启动调查；2025年5月，商务部要求英伟达提供向Megaspeed销售芯片的相关数据；6月，官员实地走访Megaspeed并约谈Alice Huang，随后司法部接手主导调查。文章称，Megaspeed于2025年6月被英伟达列入禁售名单，但《纽约时报》报道称，其马来西亚子公司Speedmatrix在之后8个月仍收到大量英伟达芯片。据称，受出口管制的英伟达Blackwell和H200芯片通过第三方或英伟达直接发货至Speedmatrix，再转手流入中国。英伟达辩称，商务部曾允许其向Megaspeed出货，而且英伟达目前仍将Megaspeed列为云合作伙伴。

从技术上看，Blackwell和H200是英伟达面向大模型训练和高吞吐推理的高端AI加速器。Blackwell代表更新一代架构，通常在AI算力、能效和规模化互联方面更强；H200属于Hopper代际的大内存带宽产品，适合需要大显存和高带宽的模型训练与推理。此类芯片的高算力、高HBM容量与带宽、高速互连能力，使其成为AI基础设施的核心，也正是美国出口管制的重点。原文未给出具体算力、显存和带宽参数，因此无法做芯片级性能对比；可确认的量化信息主要是执法与走私规模：2025年10月一项调查称，Megaspeed通过进口再出口方式协助约20亿美元英伟达芯片流入中国；美方称已对6项调查中的17名被告提出指控，近期一名加州男子因涉嫌走私逾3亿美元受出口限制的英伟达芯片被捕，最高面临20年监禁。

影响方面，此案把AI芯片出口管制从“许可证与实体清单”推向刑事执法，重点打击第三国子公司、云合作伙伴和转口贸易等规避路径。对英伟达及云服务商而言，需要加强客户尽调、最终用途和最终用户审查、转售追踪；对AI产业链而言，先进GPU和加速器的跨境流动将进一步收紧，可能推高合规成本，并加速中国本土AI芯片替代。文章的相关背景也提到，中国正推进自主半导体供应，华为Ascend NPU、CXMT DRAM等是这一背景下的替代力量。整体看，Megaspeed案既是美国出口管制执法升级的标志，也将检验其对AI算力供应链的管控能力。

items.title: Phison Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD Review: Fast PCIe 5.0 write performance for AI and ingest servers
items.description: The Phison Pascari X201P 15.36TB U.2 data center SSD meets its rated speeds and saves AI checkpoints quickly, though it trails on low-queue-depth writes.
items.content: Phison is serious about enterprise storage, and the Pascari X201P was not released lightly; it came in the night, under NDA, alongside this week’s Supercomputing 2026 event. The drive is part of the Performance X-Series, which handles intensive workloads where consistency is the name of the game. We were nevertheless pleasantly surprised by its write performance, with a steady 12 GB/s for sequential and over 600,000 random write IOPS, considering it’s marketed at the 1 drive write per day (DWPD) endurance point.Part of that surprise comes from the fact that this is Phison’s read-intensive PCIe 5.0 data center drive, a successor to the X200P. It comes in the U.2 form factor — which can be more convenient in many cases — from 1.92TB to 30.72TB, and an E3.S version from 3.84TB, in both single- and dual-port models. It stands next to its mixed-use sibling, the X201E, which is the one rated for 3 DWPD. What makes the X201P exciting, in part, is its own 16-channel X2 controller and the flash that’s inside. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original This drive is aimed at AI, analytics, and database servers, with its case made in the 4K 70/30 mix at higher queue depths. It passed Phison’s one-million-IOPS mark at QD128 in our testing of the 15.36TB model, and the drive met all of its rated specs, though its random read rating required polled I/O to reach on our bench. It faced challenges with QD1 writes, log commits, and the middle range of our mixed sweeps. Given its blend of performance, capacity, and endurance, we consider it a very competent entry from the company that was perhaps better known in the consumer SSD market until recently.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Phison Pascari X201P Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Product 1.92TB 3.84TB 7.68TB 15.36TB 30.72TB Pricing N/A N/A N/A N/A N/A Form Factor U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) Interface / Protocol PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d Controller Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 DRAM Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Memory 3D TLC 3D TLC 3D TLC 321-layer 3D TLC 3D TLC Sequential Read 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s Sequential Write 2,300 MB/s 4,600 MB/s 9,200 MB/s 11,800 MB/s 10,000 MB/s Random Read 1,400K 2,700K 3,300K 3,250K 2,800K Random Write 75K 230K 480K 600K 490K Security ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) Power-Loss Protection Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Endurance 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD Power (Active / Idle) ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W Part Number (ISE) XP208H081T92P322T0410 XP208H083T84P324T0910 XP208H087T68P328T1910 XP208H0815T3P3216T310 XP208H0830T7P3232T710 Part Number (SED) XP208H081T92P222T0410 XP208H083T84P224T0910 XP208H087T68P228T1910 XP208H0815T3P2216T310 XP208H0830T7P2232T710 Height 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm Warranty 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year The drive met or beat every rated performance figure that we can test, which should be the target of any enterprise SSD released today. If there’s an exception, it’s due to how we test; Phison lists a ceiling of 3,250K IOPS for 4K random read, which is higher than our bench allows with our interrupt-driven I/O, which we use rather than a polled approach. We also run a polled test on every drive for cases like this, and our result was 3,283K IOPS at the same queue depth Phison specifies, which shows the drive does exceed its specification.Phison Pascari X201P Features and Management Swipe to scroll horizontally Feature Phison Pascari X201P NVMe Specification NVMe 2.0d OCP Specification Datacenter NVMe SSD v2.0, with v2.6 telemetry features Host Link PCIe 5.0 x4, single port (2x2 dual-port models offered) Power-Loss Protection Yes End-to-End Data Protection Yes Security Options ISE, SED (TCG Opal 2.02) or non-SED; AES-XTS 256-bit Sanitize Cryptographic erase and block erase LBA Formats 512-byte and 4,096-byte, each with optional metadata Namespaces Up to 128 Power States Six: 25 W, 22 W, 20 W, 18 W, 15 W and 12 W maximum Temperature Thresholds 77°C warning, 85°C critical Thermal Management Host-controlled thermal management supported Firmware Slots Seven; activation without reset Out-of-Band Management NVMe-MI 1.2 over SMBus and PCIe Flexible Data Placement Not supported Tested Firmware X2WM6026 Phison Pascari X201P: A Closer Look Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Our sample is in the U.2 form factor, 15mm thick. We have the single-port SKU, ISE model XP208H0815T3P3216T310, with firmware X2WM6026. Some data we previously saw from the drive was reportedly on X2WM6025, but we confirmed X2WM6026 for all relevant results. We mounted the drive on a PCIe 5.0 x4 add-in card adapter for U.2, standing upright in the slot.Phison did not provide firm hardware details, but we were able to discover some things on our own. The flash was probably the easiest, as the company claimed it was a 321-layer part. That can only be SK hynix’s V9 TLC, which is not flash we’ve tested before in any product. It’s exceptionally fast and uses a three-deck design, which is relatively new for TLC flash. The flash could be credited with some of the exceptional performance measurements we see on the drive.As for the proprietary controller, we’ve heard that it’s using a combination of the standard Arm Cortex-R5 — these would be the main cores — with AndesCore RISC-V on the side. We’ve seen the latter before on the Phison E28 consumer SSD controller, which did have some enterprise-like aspects to it. The E28 is the newer design, built on a 6nm process with Andes’ newer N45 cores alongside the N25F, while the X2 is a 12nm part that, as far as we can tell, sticks with N25F-class co-processors.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn this case, the X2 has twice the flash channels, which enables a superior level of performance out of TLC flash, as in enterprise you do not rely on pSLC. That mix of cores sets the X2 apart from other 16-channel PCIe 5.0 enterprise controllers: Marvell’s Bravera SC5 and Silicon Motion’s SM8366 rely on Arm cores throughout, whereas Phison pairs its Cortex-R5 cores with small RISC-V co-processors.MORE: Best SSDsMORE: Best External SSDsMORE: Best SSD for the Steam DeckPhison Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD: Price Comparison No price informationCheck AmazonWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by

items.titleZh: 群联 Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD 评测：面向 AI 与数据摄取服务器的快速 PCIe 5.0 写入性能
items.descriptionZh:
群联电子（Phison）正在认真推进企业级存储业务，Pascari X201P 的发布也并非轻率之举：它在 SC 2026 期间以 NDA 方式于夜间低调亮相。该盘属于 Performance X-Series，面向对一致性要求极高的密集型工作负载。尽管其耐久度定位为 1 DWPD 的读密集型产品，实测写入性能仍超出预期——顺序写可稳定在约 12 GB/s，随机写超过 600,000 IOPS。它是群联 PCIe 5.0 数据中心读密集型 SSD，也是 X200P 的后继产品，提供 U.2 形态（1.92TB 至 30.72TB）以及从 3.84TB 起的 E3.S 版本，并有单端口和双端口型号；同系列还有混合用途、3 DWPD 的 X201E。X201P 的亮点之一，是采用群联自研 16 通道 X2 控制器及内部闪存。

该产品主要面向 AI、分析和数据库服务器，官方性能场景基于高队列深度下的 4K 70/30 混合读写。测试的 15.36TB 型号在 QD128 下通过群联百万 IOPS 门槛，并达到所有可测的额定规格；不过其随机读额定值在测试平台上需要轮询 I/O 才能达到。测试中也暴露出一些挑战，主要集中在 QD1 写入、日志提交以及混合读写扫描的中段区间。综合性能、容量和耐久度来看，这是一款非常有竞争力的企业级入门产品，尤其考虑到群联此前更广为人知的是消费级 SSD 市场。

规格方面，X201P 采用 PCIe 5.0 x4 接口和 NVMe 2.0d 协议，搭载群联 X2 控制器，配备 DRAM 和 3D TLC 闪存（15.36TB 型号为 321 层）。各容量顺序读均为 14,800 MB/s；顺序写从 1.92TB 的 2,300 MB/s、3.84TB 的 4,600 MB/s、7.68TB 的 9,200 MB/s、15.36TB 的 11,800 MB/s，到 30.72TB 的 10,000 MB/s。随机读分别为 1,400K、2,700K、3,300K、3,250K 和 2,800K IOPS；随机写分别为 75K、230K、480K、600K 和 490K IOPS。全系为 1 DWPD、5 年保修，支持掉电保护、ISE 或 SED（TCG Opal 2.02）安全选项，功耗为活动≤25W、空闲≤5W。测试样片为 U.2 15mm 单端口 ISE 型号，固件 X2WM6026；15.36TB 型号顺序写额定 11.8 GB/s，实测稳定约 12 GB/s，随机写超过 600K IOPS。随机读额定 3,250K IOPS，常规中断驱动 I/O 测试低于该值，但轮询测试在群联指定队列深度下达到 3,283K IOPS，超过额定规格。

功能与管理特性包括：符合 OCP Datacenter NVMe SSD v2.0，并具备 v2.6 遥测功能；支持端到端数据保护；安全选项包括 ISE、SED 或非 SED，AES-XTS 256 位；支持加密擦除和块擦除；LBA 格式为 512 字节和 4,096 字节，均可选元数据；最多 128 个命名空间；六档功耗状态（最高 25W、22W、20W、18W、15W、12W）；温度阈值 77°C 警告、85°C 临界；支持主机控制热管理；提供 7 个固件槽，激活无需复位；支持通过 SMBus 和 PCIe 的 NVMe-MI 1.2 带外管理；不支持灵活数据放置（FDP）。

硬件细节方面，群联未提供完整信息，但测试分析显示，其闪存大概率为 SK 海力士 321 层 V9 TLC，采用三层堆叠设计，速度很快，可能是该盘优异性能的部分来源。X2 控制器据称采用 Arm Cortex-R5 作为主核，并搭配 AndesCore RISC-V 协处理器；X2 为 12nm 工艺，使用 N25F 级协处理器，而群联消费级 E28 控制器为 6nm、采用更新的 N45 与 N25F 核心。X2 拥有双倍闪存通道（16 通道），可在企业级不依赖 pSLC 的情况下充分释放 TLC 闪存性能。与 Marvell Bravera SC5、Silicon Motion SM8366 等全 Arm 核心的 16 通道 PCIe 5.0 企业级控制器相比，群联的 Cortex-R5 加 RISC-V 协处理器组合形成了差异化设计。

总体来看，X201P 的意义在于：群联借助自研 16 通道控制器、321 层 TLC 和高容量 U.2/E3.S 形态，补强了读密集型企业级 PCIe 5.0 产品线，为 AI、分析、数据库等读多写少场景提供高容量、性能一致且 1 DWPD 的数据中心 SSD 选择。其顺序写和随机写表现突出，随机读可超过额定值，但 QD1 写入、日志提交和部分混合负载中段仍需用户按场景评估；它更适合读密集和混合偏读负载，而非写密集型应用。价格尚未公布。

items.title: 403 hyperscale US data centers used staggering 82 terawatts of electricity in a year, more than 80% of Michigan’s entire consumption
items.description: A Harvard-led study in Nature Sustainability estimates 403 US hyperscale data centers used about 82 TWh of electricity in a year.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Harvard-led study estimates that 403 hyperscale U.S. data center sites consumed about 82 TWh of electricity in a year, 1.8% of the country’s total, with more than half coming from gas and coal sources, Wired reports. This compares to the entire state of Michigan selling 99 TWh in 2024. The data centers’ pull also put out an estimated 25.7 million metric tons (Mt) of CO2, which is two to three times a 2018 estimate.Hyperscale data centers, in this case, refer to sites run by a hyperscale cloud or content provider, or a colocation operator who serves one, with a capacity in the tens of megawatts. The 675 candidate sites came from data vendor Baxtel, with 403 confirmed with satellite imagery and building-footprint maps, at an average capacity of 39.9 MW and a median of 36 MW.Nobody officially counts what the data centers actually draw from the grid. Instead, the electricity is estimated by multiplying each site’s maximum capacity by the hours in a year and an estimate of how hard the data centers run. For CO2 and the source mix, each site is placed in its grid region, of 23 total in the study, with a regional average mix from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). These are then multiplied and added up for the total number. Such estimation methods may reduce the strength of arguments against data center buildouts.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The power is also not evenly laid out, with 142 of the sites located in Virginia alone, taking 21.4 TWh, or about a quarter. PJM, a grid operator for 13 states, including Virginia, and D.C., or America’s largest grid, covers 32.8 TWh, or about 40%, more than any other region. Notably for Virginia, its power draw is actually just a bit below the 22.85 TWh estimate for all U.S. hyperscale sites from 2018. See the table for more details. Swipe to scroll horizontally Top 10 states by CO2 attributed to hyperscale data centers State Sites Electricity (TWh) CO2 (million metric tons) CO2 per kWh (g) Virginia 142 21.4 7.0 325 Iowa 26 7.2 3.2 445 Ohio 38 8.8 2.9 325 Texas 22 4.6 1.5 333 Nebraska 8 3.5 1.4 395 Oregon 56 11.1 1.3 119 Arizona 12 3.2 1.3 401 Oklahoma 8 2.9 1.1 395 Wyoming 2 1.2 1.0 848 Utah 5 1.3 0.8 640 Not all power is equal — renewables, for example, can be perceived more favorably — and 53.9% of the estimated draw comes from fossil fuels, 38.2% of the total from gas and 15.2% from coal. Renewables cover 25.3% while nuclear handles the remaining 20.9%. Estimates put this in the 21–31 Mt range for CO2 output, versus the 10.5 Mt estimate from 2018. You may like US AI data centers projected to become the fifth-largest natural gas consumer in the world by 2035 US data centers could wipe out 15 years' worth of progress in greenhouse gas emissions, report claims 'America hates data centers' — New data highlights public sentiment Estimated fuel mix of the electricity attributed to 403 U.S. hyperscale data centers (“US Total”) and to the seven grid regions with the most data center load. (Image credit: Guidi et al. / arXiv (CC BY 4.0))Estimated carbon intensity, though, is lower than the average, at 314 g of CO2 per kWh versus 348 for the entire U.S. grid, or about 10% lower. Admittedly, almost a quarter of the load is in regions dirtier than the U.S. average. The likely reason it’s lower is that the biggest loads lie in PJM territory, which is nuclear-heavy, while Oregon, for its part, is hydro-heavy. The estimates, in this case, use 2023 plant data, and the method does not trace which plant feeds which site and also leaves out clean-power contracts and credits.The study’s results also lag reality as the window ended in April 2025 and, with how much development there has been for AI, among other things, the footprint “could already be substantially larger now in 2026,” lead author Gianluca Guidi said in a statement. Another issue is that the median site capacity in the study is relatively small compared to upcoming buildouts, with many campuses now planned in the hundreds or thousands of megawatts. On-site power, such as gas plants, also may not show up in grid data.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsOfficial numbers may be forthcoming, though, as the Energy Information Administration’s pilot surveys of data center energy use are complete, and the agency is using them to design a survey of the sector, a spokesperson told Wired. The first pilots, which launched in March, relied on web surveys and in-person interviews, with 196 companies asked about energy sources, electricity use, plus servers and cooling, although not covering all states. Gauging the direct human impact is next in the chain, with Francesca Dominici, the study’s corresponding author, saying that quantifying health effects is an important next step. items.titleZh: 美国403座超大规模数据中心一年耗电高达82太瓦，超过密歇根州总用电量的80%
items.descriptionZh:
哈佛大学牵头的一项研究对美国超大规模数据中心能耗进行了设施级估算：403个已确认的超大规模数据中心站点全年用电约82 TWh，约占美国全国总用电量的1.8%；其中超过一半电力来自天然气和煤炭。作为对比，密歇根州2024年全年售电量约为99 TWh。研究还估算这些站点一年排放约2570万吨二氧化碳，是2018年类似估算的2至3倍。该研究由Wired报道，第一作者为Gianluca Guidi，通讯作者为Francesca Dominici，相关估算发布在arXiv上，属于对AI算力基础设施扩张背景下数据中心能源与环境影响的量化尝试。

研究中的“超大规模数据中心”指由超大规模云服务商或内容提供商运营的站点，或为这类客户提供服务的托管运营商站点，单站容量通常在数十兆瓦级。研究团队从数据供应商Baxtel获得675个候选站点，并通过卫星图像和建筑足迹地图确认其中403个，平均容量39.9 MW，中位容量36 MW。由于美国没有官方逐站统计数据中心实际从电网取电，研究采用自下而上的估算方法：将每个站点的最大容量乘以全年小时数，再乘以对数据中心运行强度的估计，得到用电量；随后把每个站点归入23个电网区域之一，使用美国环保署（EPA）提供的区域平均电源结构计算排放和电力来源，再逐站汇总。其方法创新主要在于设施级、站点级的细化估算，以及将站点位置与区域电网电源结构匹配，从而给出州和区域层面的用电与排放分布。

从结果看，数据中心负荷高度集中。弗吉尼亚州单独拥有142个站点，用电21.4 TWh，约占全部估算用电的四分之一；覆盖包括弗吉尼亚州和华盛顿特区在内13个州的PJM电网区域承担32.8 TWh，约占40%，是美国最大的数据中心负荷区域。弗吉尼亚州的用电量甚至略低于2018年研究对全美超大规模数据中心22.85 TWh的估算。排放方面，弗吉尼亚州 attributed CO2约700万吨，爱荷华州约320万吨，俄亥俄州约290万吨，得克萨斯州约150万吨，内布拉斯加州约140万吨，俄勒冈州约130万吨，亚利桑那州约130万吨，俄克拉荷马州约110万吨，怀俄明州约100万吨，犹他州约80万吨。电源结构上，估算总用电中化石燃料占53.9%，其中天然气38.2%、煤炭15.2%；可再生能源占25.3%，核能占20.9%。二氧化碳排放估算区间为2100万至3100万吨，而2018年估算为1050万吨。

值得注意的是，这些超大规模数据中心的估算碳强度为每千瓦时314克二氧化碳，低于美国全国电网平均的348克/千瓦时，约低10%。研究认为，原因之一是最大负荷集中在核能占比较高的PJM区域，而俄勒冈州水电占比较高；但仍有近四分之一负荷位于碳强度高于美国平均水平的区域。该估算使用2023年电厂数据，但不追踪具体哪座电厂为哪个站点供电，也未计入清洁电力采购合同和可再生能源信用，因此结果存在方法论局限。研究时间窗口截至2025年4月，考虑到AI数据中心建设速度，第一作者表示到2026年实际 footprint“可能已经大幅增加”。此外，研究中位站点容量相对当前规划中的数百兆瓦甚至数千兆瓦园区偏小，现场发电（如天然气发电）也可能不体现在电网数据中。

这项研究的现实影响在于，它为AI数据中心扩张引发的电网压力、碳排放核算和公众舆论争议提供了更细颗粒度的基线数据；但其估算方法也可能被用于削弱反对数据中心建设的论据，因为数据并非官方实测。美国能源信息署（EIA）已完成数据中心能源使用试点调查，并正据此设计行业调查；2025年3月启动的试点通过网页问卷和面对面访谈，向196家公司询问能源来源、用电、服务器和冷却等情况，但未覆盖所有州。研究团队下一步将量化数据中心对人群健康的直接影响。总体来看，该研究揭示了美国超大规模数据中心用电和排放的规模、区域集中度及电源结构特征，也凸显了在AI推动数据中心快速扩张背景下，建立官方、透明、可核验能耗统计体系的紧迫性。

history.content: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced the company’s Q3 earnings on Tuesday, without initially mentioning former CEO Jensen Huang or the details of his departure, or possible attempt at a return. On the earnings call accompanying the release, board chair Harvey Jones kicked things off by saying the board “does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO,” and that “we will not be addressing or taking questions on today’s call regarding the circumstances of Jensen’s resignation and the ongoing investigation,” before Kress started with her comments on the results.RelatedNvidia says it will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEOTech leaders are convinced that Jensen Huang’s exit was a plot against himAs it predicted in the last financial update, Nvidia is now on the list of companies that have pulled in over $100 billion in a single quarter, with revenues of $115.8 billion, up 103 percent from the same period last year and higher than its expectation of $108 billion. This quarter’s figures include data center revenues of $107.6 billion, which were up 110 percent, and edge computing (which includes the consumer gaming PC business and devices like the new RTX Spark laptops) revenue of $8.2 billion, up 42 percent.The company reported $65.3 billion in profit, a new record.“Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.”In the fourth quarter, Nvidia expects revenues of $130 billion.Update, November 17th: Added comments from Nvidia’s earnings call.

history.titleZh: 英伟达Q3财报达标，却未提及黄仁勋那档子事
history.descriptionZh: 英伟达临时CEO科莱特·克雷斯于周二公布了公司第三季度财报，但最初并未提及前CEO黄仁勋或其离职细节，也未提及他可能尝试回归一事。在随财报发布的业绩电话会议上，董事会主席哈维·琼斯首先表示，董事会“不打算让黄仁勋重新担任CEO”，并且“我们不会在今天的电话会议上就黄仁勋辞职的相关情况以及正在进行的调查作出回应或接受提问”，随后克雷斯开始就业绩发表评论。相关报道：英伟达表示不会让黄仁勋重新担任CEO；科技界领袖坚信黄仁勋的离职是针对他的阴谋。正如上次财务更新中所预测的那样，英伟达如今已跻身单季度营收超过1000亿美元的公司之列，营收达到1158亿美元，同比增长103%，高于其1080亿美元的预期。本季度数据包括数据中心营收1076亿美元，同比增长110%；边缘计算（包括消费级游戏PC业务以及新款RTX Spark笔记本电脑等设备）营收82亿美元，同比增长42%。公司报告利润为653亿美元，创下新纪录。“我们的势头是真实的。英伟达是一家卓越的技术领导者，这得益于我们员工的不懈创新，”英伟达临时CEO、执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯表示。“Vera Rubin开局强劲，我们的路线图正在按计划推进，我们的雄心从未如此之大。”英伟达预计第四季度营收为1300亿美元。更新，11月17日：补充了英伟达财报电话会议上的评论。

history.titleZh: 面向异构集成良率的缺陷感知芯粒匹配（ASU, Ampere）
history.descriptionZh:
亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）与Ampere Computing的研究人员发表了题为《DT-MATCH: Defect- and Topology-Aware Chiplet Matching for Yield Optimization in Heterogeneous Integration》的论文，研究缺陷与拓扑感知的芯粒匹配方法，用于提升异构集成良率。该工作由Semiconductor Engineering报道。

背景方面，异构集成（HI）和先进封装使基于芯粒（chiplet）的SoC设计成为可能，可以把多个裸片通过高密度die-to-die（D2D）互连集成在一个封装内，从而突破单芯片面积、工艺和成本限制。但这也带来新的良率挑战：制造缺陷会影响单个芯粒或D2D链路的可用性，复杂的D2D互连约束又要求参与集成的芯粒在拓扑和链路层面相互匹配。尤其是lane级缺陷、有限的互连资源或冗余能力等问题，可能导致原本可用的芯粒组合无法形成合格系统，从而拉低封装级良率并增加成本。

从论文标题和公开摘要看，DT-MATCH的核心思路是把芯粒匹配从传统的“已知合格裸片（KGD）筛选”推进到“缺陷与拓扑感知的组合优化”。其技术原理大致是：在异构集成组装前，利用各芯粒的测试信息、缺陷分布以及D2D互连拓扑约束，对芯粒进行优化配对和映射，使缺陷链路或受限拓扑能够通过合理的芯粒组合被规避或补偿，而不是简单丢弃有局部缺陷的芯粒。创新点在于同时考虑制造缺陷和D2D拓扑约束，特别是lane级缺陷对互连可用性的影响，将芯粒匹配建模为面向良率优化的组合问题。

性能参数和对比数据方面，目前公开的新闻摘要仅给出论文标题、研究机构和问题背景，未披露具体良率提升幅度、算法复杂度、对比基线、测试芯片结果或成本收益等量化数据，因此无法从该新闻中给出具体性能数字。后续需要查看论文全文才能确认DT-MATCH相对传统KGD筛选或缺陷无感知匹配方法在封装良率、D2D链路可用率、匹配成功率和测试成本等指标上的实际改进。

技术影响和应用场景上，该方法面向chiplet异构集成和先进封装的设计—制造协同，可用于基于芯粒的SoC、云原生CPU、HPC/AI加速器以及多裸片封装产品。Ampere Computing的参与也说明该问题与数据中心CPU的芯粒化设计密切相关。若方法有效，DT-MATCH有望减少因局部缺陷导致的整组报废，提高先进封装产线的有效良率，并降低高性能芯片的分摊成本。总体而言，该研究提出了从“筛选合格芯粒”转向“优化匹配可用芯粒组合”的思路，但具体效果仍需论文完整数据验证。

history.title: Nvidia claims its Vera CPU can gain up to 39% performance boost via software optimization at SC26 — architectural fine-tuning is needed to fully unleash custom Olympus cores
history.description: Nvidia's Vera CPU, powered by its custom Olympus Arm cores, already offers strong performance with unoptimized code, but at SC26, the company demonstrated that further software optimizations can improve performance by nearly 39% with certain workloads.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia's Vera CPU, designed as both a standalone data-center part and a host for Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 servers, offers impressive performance thanks to substantially higher execution resources per core than its predecessor, Grace. However, Nvidia admits at Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) that existing software cannot always take full advantage of Vera's resources without adaptation for the architecture.The company shared that architecture-specific software optimizations can boost Vera's performance by nearly 39% in certain computationally intensive workloads. But despite offering unbeatable single-thread performance, the CPU is not positioned for general-purpose workloads.Get the Tom's Hardware App (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Get the full Tom's Hardware experience on your device with our brand-new app. Bookmark articles, use our smart search feature, personalize your feed, and get push notifications so you never miss a beat.Download now on Apple App StoreDownload now on the Google Play StoreUnlike Grace, which relies on off-the-shelf Neoverse V2 CPU cores developed by Arm, Vera uses Nvidia's proprietary Olympus cores specifically designed to maximize per-core performance as well as to ensure high aggregate throughput. To that end, Nvidia equipped Olympus with a wide front end that features a 10-wide decoder, a neural branch predictor, a deep out-of-order execution engine, six vector execution units, four load pipelines, two store pipelines, all backed with large private caches and advanced prefetch mechanisms.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: (Image credit: Nvidia)In fact, Nvidia deliberately opted for 88 high-performance general-purpose cores with support for its proprietary spatial multithreading technology (176 threads in total) rather than maximizing the number of cores per socket, as the maximum possible single-thread performance was one of the key design goals for Vera."CPU design is really just a game of trade-offs," said Hannah Coutand, who leads Vera CPU marketing at Nvidia, in an interview with Tom's Hardware Premium. "You could maximize for a lot of cores, but literally when you maximize the die for lots of cores, you do not actually have space to maximize for IPC, like instructions per clock." You may like Benchmarking Nvidia’s Vera CPU for the data center — standalone Vera tested against Granite Rapids-AP and EPYC Turin Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down 88-core Vera CPU Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment Although Nvidia primarily positions Vera as a CPU for agentic AI and other AI-related workloads, the company originally conceived its Olympus microarchitecture with data processing applications in mind. As it turned out, the key attributes of Vera — high per-core performance, high memory bandwidth, and low memory access latency — are precisely what agentic AI workloads need as well, according to Coutand."We are very clear in our strategy with Vera and our positioning with Vera that it is not a general-purpose CPU," Coutand said. " If you want a web server for your cloud data center, there are probably other choices that are better suited for that than Vera. [Vera is made for] workloads […] that require that high per-core speed, high memory bandwidth, low latency. […] It has great fungibility for lots of workloads as long as those workloads value the things that Vera is good for."Software optimizations make good things betterTo assess the computational capabilities of Nvidia's custom Olympus microarchitecture and its advantages over Neoverse V2, Nvidia's researchers used a double-precision general matrix multiplication (DGEMM) workload based on an assembly kernel from OpenBLAS, an open-source linear algebra library. While OpenBLAS features a kernel tailored for the Arm Neoverse V2 cores that power Nvidia's Grace processor, it lacks one specifically designed for Olympus.To examine the efficiency of the two microarchitectures, the researchers used a standalone benchmark called miniKernelGEMM with a 128 × 128 matrix multiplication problem that fits into the L1 cache of both processors. (Image credit: Nvidia)The Grace CPU achieved 4.51 instructions per clock (IPC) and 13.03 FP64 operations per cycle with the Neoverse V2 kernel, whereas Vera executed 5.43 instructions per clock and 15.69 FP64 operations per cycle with the very same code, an improvement of approximately 20%. What to read next Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips SpaceXAI will deploy standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs for Grok's agentic workloads OpenAI’s Jalapeño ASICs are deployed alongside AMD EPYC ‘Turin’ CPUs as hosts, not Nvidia's Vera However, when the researchers used a kernel specifically optimized for Olympus, Vera’s performance increased to 7.53 instructions per clock and 21.75 FP64 operations per cycle. As a result, Vera outperformed its predecessor by nearly 67% on a per-core, per-clock basis in this particular workload.Grace's Neoverse V2 microarchitecture has four 128-bit SIMD pipelines that can perform a total of 16 FP64 operations per clock, whereas Nvidia's Olympus has six such pipelines that can execute up to 24 FP64 operations per cycle, a 50% improvement.But where the Neoverse V2-optimized kernel uses 81.4% of Grace's peak FP64 throughput, it uses only about 66.5% of Vera's computational capabilities. With changes to matrix tile organization, register allocation, and instruction scheduling that better suit the Olympus microarchitecture, the researchers managed to utilize 90.6% of its peak FP64 throughput, according to Nvidia's tutorial published at SC26. (Image credit: Nvidia)While software developed and optimized for existing Arm-based data center processors can still benefit from the capabilities of Nvidia's Olympus cores without any specific optimizations, the company's SC26 benchmark results demonstrate that at least some applications will need to be fine-tuned for the new microarchitecture to take full advantage of its execution resources. Of course, it remains to be seen how much performance can be gained through Olympus-specific optimizations in workloads other than matrix multiplication.As Nvidia expands beyond CPUs that primarily serve as companions to its data center GPUs and chases the standalone server CPU market, the company will have to ensure that performance-critical software takes advantage of the architectural peculiarities of its processors, much like Intel and AMD have done for decades.But the company is already deeply experienced with partner and ecosystem development for platforms like CUDA, so as Vera is more widely adopted, that experience could prove useful in spurring optimizations for these CPUs going forward.
history.author: Anton Shilov
history.titleZh: Nvidia声称其Vera CPU在SC26上通过软件优化可获得最高39%的性能提升——需要架构微调才能充分释放定制Olympus核心的潜力
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达在Supercomputing 2026（SC26）上披露了其Vera CPU的更多技术细节。Vera既是独立的数据中心CPU，也可作为英伟达Vera Rubin NVL72服务器的宿主处理器。与上一代Grace采用Arm现成的Neoverse V2核心不同，Vera使用英伟达自研的Olympus微架构核心，设计目标是最大化单核性能并保证高总体吞吐量。Olympus配备10宽解码器、神经分支预测器、深度乱序执行引擎、6个向量执行单元、4条加载流水线和2条存储流水线，并配有大容量私有缓存和高级预取机制。Vera采用88个高性能通用核心，支持英伟达专有的空间多线程技术，共176线程；英伟达刻意没有追求更多核心数量，而是优先保证单线程性能。Vera CPU营销负责人Hannah Coutand表示，CPU设计本质上是权衡取舍，最大化核心数会挤占提升IPC（每时钟指令数）的空间。

性能方面，英伟达使用基于OpenBLAS汇编内核的双精度通用矩阵乘法（DGEMM）负载，以及128×128矩阵乘法miniKernelGEMM基准（可放入两颗处理器的L1缓存）对比Grace和Vera。使用现有Neoverse V2内核时，Grace达到4.51 IPC和每周期13.03次FP64运算，Vera达到5.43 IPC和每周期15.69次FP64运算，提升约20%。但使用针对Olympus优化的内核后，Vera提升至7.53 IPC和每周期21.75次FP64运算，单核单时钟性能比Grace提升近67%。硬件上，Grace的Neoverse V2有4条128位SIMD流水线，每周期最多执行16次FP64运算；Olympus有6条，每周期最多24次，提升50%。不过，Neoverse V2优化内核只能利用Vera约66.5%的峰值FP64吞吐量，而能利用Grace峰值的81.4%；通过调整矩阵分块、寄存器分配和指令调度，英伟达将Vera的峰值利用率提升至90.6%。英伟达称，针对架构的软件优化在某些计算密集型负载中可将Vera性能提升近39%。

影响与应用场景方面，Vera并非通用CPU。Coutand明确表示，如果云数据中心需要Web服务器，Vera可能不是最佳选择；Vera面向需要高单核速度、高内存带宽和低延迟的负载，例如智能体AI（agentic AI）和数据处理。Olympus最初就是为数据处理应用构思的，而这些特性恰好也是智能体AI所需。现有为Arm数据中心处理器开发的软件无需专门优化也能从Olympus核心受益，但SC26的基准表明，至少部分应用需要针对新微架构调优才能充分利用其执行资源。随着英伟达从数据中心GPU的配套CPU扩展到独立服务器CPU市场，确保性能关键软件适配其架构特性将至关重要，正如英特尔和AMD数十年来所做的那样。英伟达在CUDA等平台的合作伙伴和生态建设方面经验深厚，随着Vera更广泛采用，这种经验可能有助于推动软件优化。

history.content: The Justice and Commerce Departments said that they are investigating Megaspeed, the Singapore-based data center company intertwined with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, after reporting suggested an investigation had been halted last year.“While we don’t typically comment on ongoing investigations, it is in the public interest to provide the facts and address inaccurate information circulating in public reporting,” the departments said in a statement issued Monday evening. The departments acknowledged there’s been “significant public attention” on Megaspeed.Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week after reports he had an affair with former Megaspeed executive and alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, who Megaspeed says left the company in August 2025. The scandal has raised questions about national security, and sparked scrutiny of Nvidia’s handling of exports of its chips to China and Megaspeed’s possible role in moving along Nvidia’s chips.RelatedSenator slams commerce secretary for flow of Nvidia AI chips to ChinaThe Nvidia scandal isn’t slowing downEarlier this month, the New York Times reported that a Commerce Department investigation into Megaspeed “came to a sudden halt” late last year after its investigators received an email from Nvidia’s general counsel, claiming Commerce Department official Jeffrey Kessler gave Nvidia permission to reach out. The case was then “quickly” handed over to the DOJ, according to the Times.The announcement today says the DOJ took the “lead role” in the investigation last year:After identifying suspicious activity through proactive monitoring of potential sensitive semiconductor diversion, the Department of Commerce initiated an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations. In May 2025, Department of Commerce investigators requested records from Nvidia concerning direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed. In June 2025, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its “no sell” list. Based on the Department of Commerce’s investigation, agents from the Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, in conjunction with Singaporean law enforcement officials, conducted an on-site, in-person, end-use check at Megaspeed in June 2025 and interviewed CEO Alice Huang.Following this enforcement action, the Department of Justice took the lead role in the criminal investigation of Megaspeed.The statement doesn’t go into detail about the current status of the case, but it says the DOJ and Commerce Department “will bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred.”

history.titleZh: 美国司法部称正在调查Megaspeed
history.descriptionZh:
美国司法部与商务部周一晚间发表声明称，正在调查新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed，并回应此前媒体报道称相关调查去年已被叫停。两部门表示，通常不对正在进行的调查置评，但出于公共利益有必要提供事实、纠正公共报道中的不准确信息，并承认Megaspeed案受到“显著公众关注”。该案与英伟达CEO黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）辞职事件交织：报道称，黄仁勋上周辞去英伟达CEO职务，此前有媒体报道他与Megaspeed前高管Alice Huang有婚外情，后者被指为中国间谍；Megaspeed称Alice Huang已于2025年8月离开公司。该丑闻引发国家安全担忧，并促使外界审视英伟达对华芯片出口的处理，以及Megaspeed可能在转运英伟达芯片中扮演的角色。相关报道还提到，有参议员抨击商务部长在英伟达AI芯片流向中国问题上的处理，且该丑闻并未降温。

《纽约时报》本月初报道称，商务部对Megaspeed的调查在去年底“突然停止”，原因是调查人员收到英伟达总法律顾问的邮件，称商务部官员Jeffrey Kessler允许英伟达联系；案件随后“迅速”移交给司法部。两部门最新声明则称，司法部去年已在调查中发挥“主导作用”。声明给出的时间线是：商务部通过对潜在敏感半导体转移的主动监控发现可疑活动，于2024年对Megaspeed启动潜在出口管制违规调查；2025年5月，商务部调查人员要求英伟达提供与Megaspeed直接或间接销售有关的记录；2025年6月，英伟达将Megaspeed列入“禁止销售”名单；同月，商务部工业与安全局（BIS）人员与新加坡执法官员在Megaspeed进行现场、面对面的最终用途检查，并采访了CEO Alice Huang。此后，司法部接管了对Megaspeed的刑事调查主导权。

本案涉及的“核心技术”并非芯片性能创新，而是敏感半导体出口管制与供应链追踪机制：通过主动监控发现可疑转移、调取企业销售记录、将相关实体列入禁售名单、开展最终用途核查，并在发现违规线索后转入刑事调查。其影响主要集中在AI芯片供应链合规、第三国数据中心可能充当转运节点的风险，以及国家安全审查对英伟达出口管理和新加坡数据中心角色的审视。声明未披露案件当前具体进展，也未提供任何芯片性能参数或对比数据，但明确表示司法部和商务部将“依法追究Megaspeed任何可能存在的犯罪行为到底”。

history.content: Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week, would be willing to return as CEO if the company’s board of directors wanted it, he said in a statement reported on by The Wall Street Journal.“Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” Huang said. “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”Huang resigned on Thursday following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and a direct report. CFO Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO.“I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life,” Huang said. “I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.”More than 193,000 people, including CEOs like Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, have signed a letter to “bring Jensen back.” President Trump has also been supportive of Huang returning as CEO, saying yesterday that it “certainly isn’t a bad idea.” (Trump had earlier tossed out former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a potential replacement.) On Monday, Nvidia’s board reportedly was “not considering” having Huang return, and today, CNN reported that the board is “not considering reinstating Huang.”Nvidia didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.Here is Huang’s full statement:Over the past week, I’ve been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I’ve never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me.I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. NVIDIA has been my life’s work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible. I love our country, and I love NVIDIA.I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life. I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.Thank you again to everyone who has shared their good wishes. I am profoundly humbled by your support. To my family: I love you, and I will spend the rest of my life being worthy of yours.JensenUpdate, November 17th: CNN reports that Nvidia’s board is not considering reinstating Huang.

history.titleZh: 黄仁勋表示愿意回归担任英伟达CEO
history.descriptionZh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋上周辞职后表示，如果公司董事会希望他回归，他愿意重新出任CEO。黄仁勋在声明中称，自离职以来，英伟达员工、投资者、商业伙伴和客户纷纷呼吁他回归。他强调，若董事会认为他的回归符合股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，他将很荣幸回应这些呼声并重返CEO岗位。黄仁勋于上周四辞职，此前有报道称他涉及两段婚外情，其中一段对象被指为中国间谍，另一段对象为直接下属。英伟达CFO Colette Kress被任命为临时CEO。黄仁勋在声明中承认自己未达到英伟达对每个人的标准，在个人生活中犯了严重错误，给董事会制造了问题，他深表遗憾，并承诺配合董事会的独立调查。超过19.3万人签署公开信呼吁“让黄仁勋回来”，签名者包括马斯克、Tim Sweeney等CEO。美国总统特朗普也支持黄仁勋回归，称这“当然不是坏主意”，并曾提及苹果前CEO Tim Cook作为潜在替代人选。然而，周一有报道称英伟达董事会“不考虑”让黄仁勋回归，CNN随后也报道董事会“不考虑恢复黄仁勋的职务”。英伟达未立即回应置评请求。黄仁勋在完整声明中回顾了自己53年前来到美国、成为美国公民的自豪感，称英伟达是他毕生的事业，与美国同事共同打造这家公司是荣幸。他再次承认个人错误，表示完全承担并配合调查。他还提到，离职后许多人直接联系他，因为公司正应对复杂的技术、市场、竞争和地缘政治动态，英伟达是一家千载难逢的公司。他最后感谢大家的支持，并向家人表达爱意。需要指出的是，该新闻原文为虚构性报道，不涉及任何核心技术原理或创新点，主要围绕公司治理与人事变动展开。

history.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before the  House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees on December 1, with Nvidia's lawyer following him on December 2. The appearances follow Huang's admission of an affair with a woman who worked for an Nvidia customer who is also believed to be a Chinese spy.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees on December 1, with an Nvidia lawyer following him on December 2, it's been confirmed. CNBC reports that the leaders of those panels broke the news today after days of speculation. Huang was asked to appear via a letter issued on November 9, just 24 hours after he admitted the affair with Alice Huang, a woman who has been accused of being a Chinese spy. Days later, it was also suggested that Mr. Huang could be issued a subpoena if he did not respond by tomorrow, November 18. That subpoena will no longer be required.“We look forward to hearing from Jensen Huang and Tim Teter on their roles in a potential breach of our national security,” Reps. Brian Mast, R-Fla., John Moolenaar, R-Mich., and Rick Crawford, R-Ark., the chairs of the Foreign Affairs, China Select, and Intelligence Committees, reportedly said after the news of the pair's December appearances was announced. "The American people need answers," they went on, noting that it would be "dangerous" to allow Chinese state actors access to advanced AI chips, the likes of which are built by Nvidia.Ms. Yuang was an executive at Megaspeed, a company that was a customer of Nvidia during Mr. Huang's tenure as CEO. Megaspeed was later added to Nvidia's no-sell list following concerns that it was involved in the smuggling of AI chips to China against U.S. export laws. Speedmatrix, a Megaspeed subsidiary, has been accused of importing Nvidia chips and then re-exporting them to China. A criminal investigation has since been launched into Megaspeed in an attempt to get to the bottom of the complicated web of AI companies and chip shipments.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Jensen Huang resigned from his role as CEO of Nvidia following his admission of an affair with Ms. Huang. Since then, reports of at least one other affair with an Nvidia employee have surfaced. Despite that fact, calls for Huang's return to the top job at Nvidia continue to gain momentum.
