history.titleZh: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before a House Foreign Affairs panel amid concerns over his affair with a suspected Chinese spy
history.descriptionZh:
美国众议院外交事务委员会、情报委员会和中国选择委员会已确认，前英伟达CEO黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）将于12月1日出席国会听证，英伟达律师蒂姆·泰特（Tim Teter）将于12月2日随后作证。CNBC报道称，这三个小组委员会的主席在数日猜测后公布了上述安排。此前，国会于11月9日致函要求黄仁勋出席，而就在一天前，他承认与Alice Huang存在婚外情；Alice Huang被指为中国间谍。随后有消息称，如果黄仁勋不在11月18日前回应，国会可能发出传票。随着12月作证安排确认，传票已不再需要。

众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特（Brian Mast）、中国选择委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔（John Moolenaar）和情报委员会主席里克·克劳福德（Rick Crawford）在声明中表示，期待听取黄仁勋和泰特在“潜在国家安全漏洞中所扮演角色”的说明，并强调“美国人民需要答案”。他们指出，允许中国国家行为者获取英伟达所制造的先进AI芯片将是“危险的”。

报道称，Alice Huang曾是Megaspeed公司高管，而Megaspeed在黄仁勋担任英伟达CEO期间是英伟达客户。由于担心该公司违反美国出口法律、参与向中国走私AI芯片，Megaspeed后来被列入英伟达的禁售名单。其子公司Speedmatrix被指控进口英伟达芯片后再出口至中国。目前，针对Megaspeed的刑事调查已经启动，以厘清涉及AI公司和芯片运输的复杂网络。

从技术层面看，这一事件的核心并非英伟达芯片的架构创新或性能参数，而是先进AI芯片的出口管制与合规风险。先进AI加速芯片是训练和部署大模型的关键硬件，美国出口限制旨在防止此类算力被中国国家行为者获取。Megaspeed及其子公司被指通过进口后再出口的方式规避管制，形成芯片走私链条，因而触发国会和刑事调查。原文未披露具体芯片型号、性能指标或对比数据。

事件背景是，黄仁勋在承认与Alice Huang的婚外情后辞去英伟达CEO职务；此后又有报道称他至少还与一名英伟达员工存在婚外情。尽管如此，要求黄仁勋回归英伟达最高职位的呼声仍在增加。国会听证将聚焦其任职期间与Megaspeed的关系、英伟达出口合规机制，以及先进AI芯片可能经由客户和子公司流向中国的国家安全影响。该事件也凸显AI芯片出口管制在执行层面的挑战：企业客户审查、最终用途追踪和跨国转口贸易监管，正成为AI算力供应链安全的重要环节。

history.title: Taipei 101 lit up in support of Jensen Huang
history.description: The Taipei 101 skyscraper was lit up with messages of support for Jensen Huang overnight, the former Nvidia CEO who left the company after admitting to an affair with a former customer who has been accused of being a Chinese Spy. Another affair, this time with an employee, has since been reported.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 3 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a Taiwanese skyscraper became the backdrop for a series of messages in support of the ousted founder, who admitted to having an affair with a woman who has been accused of being a spy for the Chinese government. The U.S. government has since announced a criminal investigation into the company the woman worked for, Megaspeed, over concerns it may have aided in the breaking of export controls related to Nvidia AI chips. Despite that fact, CNA reports that the Taipei 101 building saw messages projected onto its exterior on the night of November 16. The messages included “Taiwan ♡ Jensen,” “Family ♡ Friendship,” and “Thrive Together,” with the driving force likely to be Huang's almost celebrity-like level of fame in the country.That celebrity status has seen public sympathy for Huang grow within Taiwan, with people within the country's technology industry coming together to fund the project. One technology worker reportedly said that the light show was supposed to “bring back Jensen Huang” and show Taiwan's concern.Taipei 101 lights up in support of scandal-hit Jensen Huang Taipei 101 lit up with messages of support for Jensen Huang on Monday evening, days after he resigned as Nvidia CEO amid revelations about his extramarital affairs & mounting scrutiny over national security concerns. https://t.co/VOtX1RX5qNNovember 16, 2026That concern may not be needed for too much longer. Recent reports suggest that Huang could be plotting a return to the top job at Nvidia just days after he handed in his resignation. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney have already thrown their weight behind the idea of Huang's return to Nvidia. The clamor to force the hand of Nvidia's board has also extended to the White House, with U.S. President Trump also calling for the former CEO to be reinstated. This is despite ongoing uncertainty over whether his love interest was a Chinese spy and, if so, how much Huang may have known about that fact. Trump, however, says that Huang did not put national security at risk.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: For its part, it isn't believed that the Nvidia board is seriously considering allowing Huang to pick up where he left off pre-resignation. A source told CNBC that the company is focused on investigating Huang's conduct and a national security investigation and is not discussing his return. That investigation will no doubt also consider reports that Huang had another affair, this time with an Nvidia executive.For now, Nvidia's former CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO. Kress hasn't had long to settle in ahead of the first big test — the company's first earnings call since the scandal will take place today, November 17. history.descriptionZh:
英伟达创始人兼CEO黄仁勋辞职后，事件迅速从公司治理危机扩展为涉及国家安全、出口管制和台湾公众情绪的复杂风波。辞职背景是黄仁勋承认与一名女子有婚外情，而该女子被指为中国政府间谍；美国随后宣布对这名女子所在公司Megaspeed展开刑事调查，担心该公司可能协助规避与英伟达AI芯片相关的出口管制。尽管存在这些争议，台湾中央社报道称，台北101大楼在11月16日晚间投射出“Taiwan ♡ Jensen”“Family ♡ Friendship”“Thrive Together”等支持信息。报道指出，黄仁勋在台湾具有近乎名人般的知名度，台湾科技业界人士还集资资助了这次灯光秀，一名科技从业者称活动意在“把黄仁勋带回来”，表达台湾对他的关心。这反映出黄仁勋在台湾科技产业中的象征性影响力，以及公众对其处境的同情。

随后有报道称，黄仁勋可能在递交辞呈数日后谋划重返英伟达最高职位。SpaceX CEO埃隆·马斯克和Epic Games CEO蒂姆·斯威尼已公开支持其回归，要求英伟达董事会让黄仁勋复职的呼声还延伸到白宫，美国总统特朗普也呼吁恢复其职位。特朗普表示，黄仁勋并未将国家安全置于风险之中。不过，围绕其情人是否为中国间谍、以及黄仁勋对此知情程度的不确定性仍然存在。知情人士对CNBC表示，英伟达董事会并未认真考虑让黄仁勋复职，公司当前重点是调查其行为以及国家安全相关问题，同时还会考虑有关黄仁勋与一名英伟达高管存在另一段婚外情的报道。公司治理因此进入高度不确定阶段：一边是政治人物和行业领袖的复职呼声，另一边是董事会调查与国家安全审查。

目前，英伟达前CFO科莱特·克雷斯担任临时CEO。她上任不久便面临首次重大考验——公司自丑闻以来的首场财报电话会于11月17日举行。原文未披露任何AI芯片性能参数、产品对比数据或具体技术原理，事件核心并非芯片架构创新，而是英伟达领导层更替、出口合规与国家安全审查对公司声誉和投资者信心的冲击。英伟达AI芯片广泛应用于数据中心训练和推理等场景，且长期处于美国对华出口管制敏感地带，因此Megaspeed调查及黄仁勋事件可能影响市场对英伟达合规风险和供应链稳定性的判断。整体来看，这一事件已从高管个人丑闻演变为牵动台湾舆论、美国政治、公司董事会和出口管制执法的多层面危机，英伟达短期内的治理稳定性和财报沟通将成为外界关注焦点。

history.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
history.description: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance […]
history.content: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing. He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory. “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries, he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. At Argonne National Laboratory, Buck said, an agent built with the toolkit took a single prompt, planned and tested hypotheses, chose which simulations to run and identified two new binding sites. “You own your data. You own the model,” Buck said. Buck highlighted other agents already in use: GROMACS: An agent from KTH Royal Institute of Technology repairs broken GROMACS setups on its own. In one overnight run on a single DGX Spark, it fixed 81% of test cases. SETI Institute: At the Allen Telescope Array, an agent took a one-line prompt to plot a methanol line. Buck explained that it then retuned for Doppler shift on its own [NGC 869 vs. 896, check slide]. Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens. CPUs for the Agent Loop Agents lean on CPUs to run tool calls between model steps, Buck explained. “That’s exactly what agents need,” he said. “They need a CPU that can run, evaluate, run the tool, perform the operations, gather the results.” DKRZ, the German Climate Computing Center, has selected Vera CPUs for its HLRE-5 supercomputer, expected in early 2028. Buck said it joins Vera systems already announced at Texas Advanced Computing Center. A New GPU for Science Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the Vera Rubin platform, built for science, engineering, analytics and AI, Buck said. It supports precisions from FP64 to FP4, adds sparse-data acceleration and connects over seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink. With more than 50,000 CUDA cores, it has about three times as many as Hopper, Buck said. It is expected in 2028. Quantum Error Correction Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold. The work is being added to CUDA-Q. NVIDIA, IBM and Fermilab announced plans today for a quantum computing co-design platform to support error-correction and applications research. NVIDIA and IBM are pairing NVIDIA DGX B200 systems with IBM quantum computers, including those powered by IBM Quantum Nighthawk. Buck also introduced a new breakthrough for quantum decoding. The goal, Buck explained, is to cut decoding latency from about 300 microseconds to 10. A new CUDA-Q decoding algorithm, TCBP-JOBS, cuts error-correction research computation from 12 weeks to 45 minutes, he said. Networking Buck also showed one of the first deployments of NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics switches, at Lambda. He said they are 15x more reliable on bit errors and link flaps. history.titleZh: 伊恩·巴克为NVIDIA在SC26的周活动揭幕，科学迈入智能体时代
history.descriptionZh:
在芝加哥举行的SC26超算大会上，NVIDIA超大规模与高性能计算副总裁Ian Buck在特别演讲中发布了一系列面向科学发现的AI智能体工具、Nemotron for Science开放模型、Rubin HPC GPU、扩展的Vera CPU平台，以及NVIDIA与IBM、费米国家加速器实验室在量子计算领域的新合作。Buck回顾了20年前在SC06教程上首次公开讲解CUDA，指出NVIDIA目前已有1000多个CUDA-X库。他表示，计算前沿和新的科学计算栈仍以模拟为基础，但将与AI、量子计算以及智能体协同工作。

在AI智能体方面，Buck称智能体正在改变研究人员与超算、设备和仪器交互以及开展研究的方式。Nemotron for Science将Nemotron 3.5 Super VL开放模型与新的开放化学数据集、面向生命科学和化学的后训练配方相结合，可在DGX Spark、工作站或研究人员自有超算上本地运行，强调“数据归用户所有、模型归用户所有”。在阿贡国家实验室，基于该工具包构建的智能体接收单条提示后，自主规划并检验假设、选择要运行的模拟，并识别出两个新的结合位点。其他案例包括：瑞典皇家理工学院的GROMACS智能体可自行修复损坏的GROMACS配置，在单台DGX Spark上夜间运行修复了81%的测试案例；SETI研究所艾伦望远镜阵列的智能体根据一行提示绘制甲醇谱线，并自行重新调整多普勒频移；NVIDIA的Nsight AI移植智能体将天气预报与研究模型WRF中的一个例程移植到GPU，使用约1.5亿token实现5倍以上加速。

在硬件方面，Buck解释智能体在模型步骤之间执行工具调用依赖CPU，因此需要能够运行、评估、调用工具、执行操作并收集结果的CPU。德国气候计算中心DKRZ已选择Vera CPU用于其预计2028年初上线的HLRE-5超算，加入此前已宣布的得克萨斯高级计算中心等Vera系统。Rubin HPC是Vera Rubin平台中面向科学、工程、分析和AI的新GPU，支持从FP64到FP4的精度，增加稀疏数据加速，采用第七代NVLink，拥有超过5万个CUDA核心，约为Hopper的三倍，预计2028年推出。

量子计算方面，Buck称在Jülich JUPITER超算上的模拟显示，一种名为“魔法态培养”的技术可将一个逻辑步骤所需的操作减少十倍，该工作正被加入CUDA-Q。NVIDIA、IBM和费米实验室宣布计划共建量子计算协同设计平台，支持纠错与应用研究；NVIDIA DGX B200系统将与IBM量子计算机配对，包括由IBM Quantum Nighthawk驱动的系统。Buck还介绍了量子解码的新突破：目标是将解码延迟从约300微秒降至10微秒；新的CUDA-Q解码算法TCBP-JOBS可将纠错研究计算从12周缩短至45分钟。网络方面，NVIDIA Photonics共封装光学交换机在Lambda首批部署，在位错误和链路闪断方面的可靠性提升15倍。

history.title: Nvidia warns customers of new US rule that could expose them to lawsuits for serving Chinese clients
history.description: This warning comes amid Jensen Huang's scandal, a new rule from the U.S. Department of Commerce, and a pending bill in the Senate.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 6 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter CNBC reports that Nvidia has started warning its customers that impending legislation to clamp down on countries accessing AI GPUs remotely via data center rentals could put them in trouble with U.S. authorities. Chinese tech companies could take advantage of the performance of American AI hardware through a loophole in U.S. regulations. Instead of importing Nvidia chips, which are under export controls, they instead look to data centers located abroad and export their data instead. This is what Chinese AI lab Moonshot is apparently trying in Europe, which is why the U.S. Department of Commerce, through the Bureau of Industry and Security [PDF], released an interim final rule closing this loophole.According to the report, Nvidia has been messaging chip buyers to warn that RASA could expose both Nvidia and chip buyers to legal risk.The U.S. House of Representatives has already passed a bill called the Remote Access Security Act (RASA) that addressed this specific loophole, but it’s been in limbo in the Senate for over ten months now. It remains unclear if the Jensen Huang affair and suspected espionage scandal will help speed up its approval, but scheduling could be tight with only about 31 calendar days remaining before the Senate's adjournment. But even before any of these regulations are approved and published, the company is already taking steps to protect its customers and has started requiring partners that 51% of their services should go to non-Chinese clients. It has also required its partners to join Nvidia’s Fleet Intelligence tracking system if they want to retain their official partner statusLatest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: It’s unclear if these changes have been planned over time or were a reaction to the renewed scrutiny that Nvidia is facing. But even though Jensen Huang is now out of the company, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that it’s unclear if the former Nvidia CEO was aware of the alleged smuggling operations and instead laid the blame on the entire company. Nvidia itself has taken steps to improve its security and export control teams by establishing an oversight committee that will be in charge of its “national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risk management,” and would work with third-party experts in law, national security, and trade compliance.These measures would further tighten the noose around China’s AI GPUs. Even though it has several domestic chip makers, many AI operators still prefer Nvidia chips for their performance and reliability. There have even been allegations that Alibaba and ByteDance, some of China’s biggest tech companies, prefer training their LLMs in Southeast Asia to bypass bans and restrictions. So, if the U.S. finally shuts down this loophole, we can expect these companies to scramble and find a replacement for the Nvidia GPUs they could access right now. history.titleZh: 英伟达警告客户：美国新规或致其因服务中国客户而面临诉讼
history.descriptionZh:
CNBC报道称，英伟达已开始向客户发出警告：美国正在推进的远程访问安全法案（Remote Access Security Act，RASA）可能让通过海外数据中心远程租用AI GPU的国家和企业面临美国法律风险，也可能使英伟达及芯片买家同时暴露于合规风险。该问题的背景是，美国出口管制主要限制英伟达AI芯片的对华出口，但中国科技公司可以通过监管漏洞，不直接进口受管制芯片，而是在境外数据中心远程调用美国AI硬件并回传数据，从而获得接近进口芯片的算力。报道称，中国AI实验室Moonshot正试图在欧洲采用这种方式。为此，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）已发布临时最终规则，着手关闭这一远程访问漏洞；美国众议院也已通过RASA，但该法案在参议院搁置超过10个月，距离参议院休会仅剩约31个日历日，能否借近期争议加速通过仍不确定。

从技术监管原理看，这一漏洞的核心在于出口管制此前主要针对实体芯片跨境流动，而云计算和远程算力服务使境外用户无需获得硬件即可使用受控AI GPU，形成“硬件不出境、算力跨境”的监管空白。RASA和BIS规则试图把远程访问AI服务器、GPU云服务纳入类似出口管制的合规框架。报道未披露具体算力、带宽或能效对比参数，但指出许多中国AI运营者仍因性能和可靠性优势偏好英伟达芯片；即使中国已有本土芯片厂商，英伟达GPU在AI训练等场景中仍具吸引力。还有指控称，阿里巴巴和字节跳动等中国大型科技公司偏好在中国以外、尤其是东南亚训练大语言模型，以绕过禁令和限制。

在立法尚未最终完成前，英伟达已在客户合规层面采取措施：要求合作伙伴至少51%的服务面向非中国客户，并要求合作伙伴加入英伟达的Fleet Intelligence追踪系统，才能保留官方合作伙伴身份。公司还成立了监督委员会，负责其“国家安全政策、出口管制合规和全球贸易风险管理”，并与法律、国家安全和贸易合规领域的第三方专家合作。报道还提到围绕黄仁勋的争议及疑似走私/间谍风波可能影响立法节奏，并称美国财长斯科特·贝森特表示尚不清楚黄仁勋是否知晓相关涉嫌走私操作，而将责任归于公司整体。

总体看，若美国最终堵住远程访问漏洞，中国AI企业通过境外数据中心调用英伟达GPU的路径将明显收窄，相关公司可能被迫加快寻找国产或其他替代算力，并调整大模型训练地点和云服务架构。这一规则的影响不仅在于芯片硬件出口，更在于把AI算力服务、云租赁和远程访问纳入出口管制与合规追踪范围，进一步收紧中国获取高端AI GPU的渠道。

history.title: US government confirms criminal investigation into Singapore company at the heart of Jensen Huang scandal
history.description: The Justice and Commerce Departments have announced an investigation into Megaspeed over concerns that it may have been involved in the illegal export of Nvidia's AI hardware. The company was previously run by the woman officials have accused of being a Chinese spy while having an affair with Jensen Huang while he was Nvidia CEO.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A criminal investigation into Megaspeed has been confirmed by the United States Justice and Commerce Departments, with a joint statement saying that they will “bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred.” Authorities believe that Megaspeed is one of a raft of companies that may have circumvented export rules designed to limit the sale of advanced AI chips, like those built by Nvidia, to approved companies and countries. The company is at the heart of the recent Jensen Huang scandal, which saw him resign from the company last week.Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedMegaspeed was added to Nvidia's no-sell list in June 2025, the statement reveals, but a New York Times report claims that a Malaysian Megaspeed subsidiary continued to receive large shipments of Nvidia chips for a full eight months after that date. It's believed that Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell and H200 chips were shipped to Speedmatrix, either via third parties or directly from Nvidia itself, before being handed off to China. Nvidia has argued that it was given Commerce Department permission to ship the components to Megaspeed. Notably, Nvidia continues to list Megaspeed as a cloud partner.The new criminal investigation follows a Commerce Department investigation into Megaspeed that first kicked off in 2024 over possible export violations. By May 2025, it had requested Nvidia's data relating to sales it made to Megaspeed, and by June, officials visited Megaspeed and even interviewed Alice Huang, the now-former executive who is allegedly a Chinese spy. Ms. Huang is also the woman that then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with before resigning his position earlier this month. Following that visit, the Justice Department took the lead in the investigation into Megaspeed.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Joint Statement from Department of Commerce and Department of Justice on Megaspeed Investigation. https://t.co/aAdtN9aDfFNovember 17, 2026Megaspeed has long been accused of being a front for an AI component smuggling operation. In October 2025, an investigation claimed that it had helped move around $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips into China by importing them and then re-exporting them to the country. Megaspeed says that it complies with all laws and that the woman at the center of the affair scandal, Ms. Huang, is no longer at the company. The Chinese government has also dismissed claims that she was a state spy.The joint Commerce and Justice Departments' statement pointed to its strong track record when prosecuting chip smugglers to date. 17 defendants across a total of six investigations have been charged so far, with more likely to follow. A Californian man was recently arrested after being accused of smuggling more than $300 million worth of export-restricted Nvidia chips to China. He now faces up to 20 years in prison. history.titleZh: 美国政府证实对处于黄仁勋丑闻核心的新加坡公司展开刑事调查
history.descriptionZh:
美国商务部与司法部已确认对Megaspeed展开刑事调查，并在联合声明中表示，将“动用法律的全部力量”追究该公司可能存在的犯罪行为。执法部门认为，Megaspeed是涉嫌规避美国先进AI芯片出口管制的公司之一。相关管制要求英伟达等厂商的高端AI芯片只能出售给获批企业和国家。Megaspeed同时处于黄仁勋丑闻的中心：文章称，时任英伟达CEO黄仁勋因与该公司前高管Alice Huang的婚外情曝光而辞职；Alice Huang还被指为中国间谍，但中国政府否认这一说法，Megaspeed也表示她已离开公司，并称公司遵守所有法律。

案件时间线显示，美国商务部早在2024年就因潜在出口违规对Megaspeed启动调查；2025年5月，商务部要求英伟达提供向Megaspeed销售芯片的相关数据；6月，官员实地走访Megaspeed并约谈Alice Huang，随后司法部接手主导调查。文章称，Megaspeed于2025年6月被英伟达列入禁售名单，但《纽约时报》报道称，其马来西亚子公司Speedmatrix在之后8个月仍收到大量英伟达芯片。据称，受出口管制的英伟达Blackwell和H200芯片通过第三方或英伟达直接发货至Speedmatrix，再转手流入中国。英伟达辩称，商务部曾允许其向Megaspeed出货，而且英伟达目前仍将Megaspeed列为云合作伙伴。

从技术上看，Blackwell和H200是英伟达面向大模型训练和高吞吐推理的高端AI加速器。Blackwell代表更新一代架构，通常在AI算力、能效和规模化互联方面更强；H200属于Hopper代际的大内存带宽产品，适合需要大显存和高带宽的模型训练与推理。此类芯片的高算力、高HBM容量与带宽、高速互连能力，使其成为AI基础设施的核心，也正是美国出口管制的重点。原文未给出具体算力、显存和带宽参数，因此无法做芯片级性能对比；可确认的量化信息主要是执法与走私规模：2025年10月一项调查称，Megaspeed通过进口再出口方式协助约20亿美元英伟达芯片流入中国；美方称已对6项调查中的17名被告提出指控，近期一名加州男子因涉嫌走私逾3亿美元受出口限制的英伟达芯片被捕，最高面临20年监禁。

影响方面，此案把AI芯片出口管制从“许可证与实体清单”推向刑事执法，重点打击第三国子公司、云合作伙伴和转口贸易等规避路径。对英伟达及云服务商而言，需要加强客户尽调、最终用途和最终用户审查、转售追踪；对AI产业链而言，先进GPU和加速器的跨境流动将进一步收紧，可能推高合规成本，并加速中国本土AI芯片替代。文章的相关背景也提到，中国正推进自主半导体供应，华为Ascend NPU、CXMT DRAM等是这一背景下的替代力量。整体看，Megaspeed案既是美国出口管制执法升级的标志，也将检验其对AI算力供应链的管控能力。

history.title: Phison Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD Review: Fast PCIe 5.0 write performance for AI and ingest servers
history.description: The Phison Pascari X201P 15.36TB U.2 data center SSD meets its rated speeds and saves AI checkpoints quickly, though it trails on low-queue-depth writes.
history.content: Phison is serious about enterprise storage, and the Pascari X201P was not released lightly; it came in the night, under NDA, alongside this week’s Supercomputing 2026 event. The drive is part of the Performance X-Series, which handles intensive workloads where consistency is the name of the game. We were nevertheless pleasantly surprised by its write performance, with a steady 12 GB/s for sequential and over 600,000 random write IOPS, considering it’s marketed at the 1 drive write per day (DWPD) endurance point.Part of that surprise comes from the fact that this is Phison’s read-intensive PCIe 5.0 data center drive, a successor to the X200P. It comes in the U.2 form factor — which can be more convenient in many cases — from 1.92TB to 30.72TB, and an E3.S version from 3.84TB, in both single- and dual-port models. It stands next to its mixed-use sibling, the X201E, which is the one rated for 3 DWPD. What makes the X201P exciting, in part, is its own 16-channel X2 controller and the flash that’s inside. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original This drive is aimed at AI, analytics, and database servers, with its case made in the 4K 70/30 mix at higher queue depths. It passed Phison’s one-million-IOPS mark at QD128 in our testing of the 15.36TB model, and the drive met all of its rated specs, though its random read rating required polled I/O to reach on our bench. It faced challenges with QD1 writes, log commits, and the middle range of our mixed sweeps. Given its blend of performance, capacity, and endurance, we consider it a very competent entry from the company that was perhaps better known in the consumer SSD market until recently.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Phison Pascari X201P Specifications Swipe to scroll horizontally Product 1.92TB 3.84TB 7.68TB 15.36TB 30.72TB Pricing N/A N/A N/A N/A N/A Form Factor U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) U.2 (15 mm) Interface / Protocol PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d PCIe 5.0 x4 / NVMe 2.0d Controller Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 Phison X2 DRAM Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Yes (size not published) Memory 3D TLC 3D TLC 3D TLC 321-layer 3D TLC 3D TLC Sequential Read 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s 14,800 MB/s Sequential Write 2,300 MB/s 4,600 MB/s 9,200 MB/s 11,800 MB/s 10,000 MB/s Random Read 1,400K 2,700K 3,300K 3,250K 2,800K Random Write 75K 230K 480K 600K 490K Security ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) ISE or SED (TCG Opal 2.02) Power-Loss Protection Yes Yes Yes Yes Yes Endurance 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD 1 DWPD Power (Active / Idle) ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W ≤25 W / ≤5 W Part Number (ISE) XP208H081T92P322T0410 XP208H083T84P324T0910 XP208H087T68P328T1910 XP208H0815T3P3216T310 XP208H0830T7P3232T710 Part Number (SED) XP208H081T92P222T0410 XP208H083T84P224T0910 XP208H087T68P228T1910 XP208H0815T3P2216T310 XP208H0830T7P2232T710 Height 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm 15 mm Warranty 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year 5-Year The drive met or beat every rated performance figure that we can test, which should be the target of any enterprise SSD released today. If there’s an exception, it’s due to how we test; Phison lists a ceiling of 3,250K IOPS for 4K random read, which is higher than our bench allows with our interrupt-driven I/O, which we use rather than a polled approach. We also run a polled test on every drive for cases like this, and our result was 3,283K IOPS at the same queue depth Phison specifies, which shows the drive does exceed its specification.Phison Pascari X201P Features and Management Swipe to scroll horizontally Feature Phison Pascari X201P NVMe Specification NVMe 2.0d OCP Specification Datacenter NVMe SSD v2.0, with v2.6 telemetry features Host Link PCIe 5.0 x4, single port (2x2 dual-port models offered) Power-Loss Protection Yes End-to-End Data Protection Yes Security Options ISE, SED (TCG Opal 2.02) or non-SED; AES-XTS 256-bit Sanitize Cryptographic erase and block erase LBA Formats 512-byte and 4,096-byte, each with optional metadata Namespaces Up to 128 Power States Six: 25 W, 22 W, 20 W, 18 W, 15 W and 12 W maximum Temperature Thresholds 77°C warning, 85°C critical Thermal Management Host-controlled thermal management supported Firmware Slots Seven; activation without reset Out-of-Band Management NVMe-MI 1.2 over SMBus and PCIe Flexible Data Placement Not supported Tested Firmware X2WM6026 Phison Pascari X201P: A Closer Look Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Our sample is in the U.2 form factor, 15mm thick. We have the single-port SKU, ISE model XP208H0815T3P3216T310, with firmware X2WM6026. Some data we previously saw from the drive was reportedly on X2WM6025, but we confirmed X2WM6026 for all relevant results. We mounted the drive on a PCIe 5.0 x4 add-in card adapter for U.2, standing upright in the slot.Phison did not provide firm hardware details, but we were able to discover some things on our own. The flash was probably the easiest, as the company claimed it was a 321-layer part. That can only be SK hynix’s V9 TLC, which is not flash we’ve tested before in any product. It’s exceptionally fast and uses a three-deck design, which is relatively new for TLC flash. The flash could be credited with some of the exceptional performance measurements we see on the drive.As for the proprietary controller, we’ve heard that it’s using a combination of the standard Arm Cortex-R5 — these would be the main cores — with AndesCore RISC-V on the side. We’ve seen the latter before on the Phison E28 consumer SSD controller, which did have some enterprise-like aspects to it. The E28 is the newer design, built on a 6nm process with Andes’ newer N45 cores alongside the N25F, while the X2 is a 12nm part that, as far as we can tell, sticks with N25F-class co-processors.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsIn this case, the X2 has twice the flash channels, which enables a superior level of performance out of TLC flash, as in enterprise you do not rely on pSLC. That mix of cores sets the X2 apart from other 16-channel PCIe 5.0 enterprise controllers: Marvell’s Bravera SC5 and Silicon Motion’s SM8366 rely on Arm cores throughout, whereas Phison pairs its Cortex-R5 cores with small RISC-V co-processors.MORE: Best SSDsMORE: Best External SSDsMORE: Best SSD for the Steam DeckPhison Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD: Price Comparison No price informationCheck AmazonWe check over 250 million products every day for the best pricespowered by

history.titleZh: 群联 Pascari X201P 15.36TB SSD 评测：面向 AI 与数据摄取服务器的快速 PCIe 5.0 写入性能
history.descriptionZh:
群联电子（Phison）正在认真推进企业级存储业务，Pascari X201P 的发布也并非轻率之举：它在 SC 2026 期间以 NDA 方式于夜间低调亮相。该盘属于 Performance X-Series，面向对一致性要求极高的密集型工作负载。尽管其耐久度定位为 1 DWPD 的读密集型产品，实测写入性能仍超出预期——顺序写可稳定在约 12 GB/s，随机写超过 600,000 IOPS。它是群联 PCIe 5.0 数据中心读密集型 SSD，也是 X200P 的后继产品，提供 U.2 形态（1.92TB 至 30.72TB）以及从 3.84TB 起的 E3.S 版本，并有单端口和双端口型号；同系列还有混合用途、3 DWPD 的 X201E。X201P 的亮点之一，是采用群联自研 16 通道 X2 控制器及内部闪存。

该产品主要面向 AI、分析和数据库服务器，官方性能场景基于高队列深度下的 4K 70/30 混合读写。测试的 15.36TB 型号在 QD128 下通过群联百万 IOPS 门槛，并达到所有可测的额定规格；不过其随机读额定值在测试平台上需要轮询 I/O 才能达到。测试中也暴露出一些挑战，主要集中在 QD1 写入、日志提交以及混合读写扫描的中段区间。综合性能、容量和耐久度来看，这是一款非常有竞争力的企业级入门产品，尤其考虑到群联此前更广为人知的是消费级 SSD 市场。

规格方面，X201P 采用 PCIe 5.0 x4 接口和 NVMe 2.0d 协议，搭载群联 X2 控制器，配备 DRAM 和 3D TLC 闪存（15.36TB 型号为 321 层）。各容量顺序读均为 14,800 MB/s；顺序写从 1.92TB 的 2,300 MB/s、3.84TB 的 4,600 MB/s、7.68TB 的 9,200 MB/s、15.36TB 的 11,800 MB/s，到 30.72TB 的 10,000 MB/s。随机读分别为 1,400K、2,700K、3,300K、3,250K 和 2,800K IOPS；随机写分别为 75K、230K、480K、600K 和 490K IOPS。全系为 1 DWPD、5 年保修，支持掉电保护、ISE 或 SED（TCG Opal 2.02）安全选项，功耗为活动≤25W、空闲≤5W。测试样片为 U.2 15mm 单端口 ISE 型号，固件 X2WM6026；15.36TB 型号顺序写额定 11.8 GB/s，实测稳定约 12 GB/s，随机写超过 600K IOPS。随机读额定 3,250K IOPS，常规中断驱动 I/O 测试低于该值，但轮询测试在群联指定队列深度下达到 3,283K IOPS，超过额定规格。

功能与管理特性包括：符合 OCP Datacenter NVMe SSD v2.0，并具备 v2.6 遥测功能；支持端到端数据保护；安全选项包括 ISE、SED 或非 SED，AES-XTS 256 位；支持加密擦除和块擦除；LBA 格式为 512 字节和 4,096 字节，均可选元数据；最多 128 个命名空间；六档功耗状态（最高 25W、22W、20W、18W、15W、12W）；温度阈值 77°C 警告、85°C 临界；支持主机控制热管理；提供 7 个固件槽，激活无需复位；支持通过 SMBus 和 PCIe 的 NVMe-MI 1.2 带外管理；不支持灵活数据放置（FDP）。

硬件细节方面，群联未提供完整信息，但测试分析显示，其闪存大概率为 SK 海力士 321 层 V9 TLC，采用三层堆叠设计，速度很快，可能是该盘优异性能的部分来源。X2 控制器据称采用 Arm Cortex-R5 作为主核，并搭配 AndesCore RISC-V 协处理器；X2 为 12nm 工艺，使用 N25F 级协处理器，而群联消费级 E28 控制器为 6nm、采用更新的 N45 与 N25F 核心。X2 拥有双倍闪存通道（16 通道），可在企业级不依赖 pSLC 的情况下充分释放 TLC 闪存性能。与 Marvell Bravera SC5、Silicon Motion SM8366 等全 Arm 核心的 16 通道 PCIe 5.0 企业级控制器相比，群联的 Cortex-R5 加 RISC-V 协处理器组合形成了差异化设计。

总体来看，X201P 的意义在于：群联借助自研 16 通道控制器、321 层 TLC 和高容量 U.2/E3.S 形态，补强了读密集型企业级 PCIe 5.0 产品线，为 AI、分析、数据库等读多写少场景提供高容量、性能一致且 1 DWPD 的数据中心 SSD 选择。其顺序写和随机写表现突出，随机读可超过额定值，但 QD1 写入、日志提交和部分混合负载中段仍需用户按场景评估；它更适合读密集和混合偏读负载，而非写密集型应用。价格尚未公布。

history.title: 403 hyperscale US data centers used staggering 82 terawatts of electricity in a year, more than 80% of Michigan’s entire consumption
history.description: A Harvard-led study in Nature Sustainability estimates 403 US hyperscale data centers used about 82 TWh of electricity in a year.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Harvard-led study estimates that 403 hyperscale U.S. data center sites consumed about 82 TWh of electricity in a year, 1.8% of the country’s total, with more than half coming from gas and coal sources, Wired reports. This compares to the entire state of Michigan selling 99 TWh in 2024. The data centers’ pull also put out an estimated 25.7 million metric tons (Mt) of CO2, which is two to three times a 2018 estimate.Hyperscale data centers, in this case, refer to sites run by a hyperscale cloud or content provider, or a colocation operator who serves one, with a capacity in the tens of megawatts. The 675 candidate sites came from data vendor Baxtel, with 403 confirmed with satellite imagery and building-footprint maps, at an average capacity of 39.9 MW and a median of 36 MW.Nobody officially counts what the data centers actually draw from the grid. Instead, the electricity is estimated by multiplying each site’s maximum capacity by the hours in a year and an estimate of how hard the data centers run. For CO2 and the source mix, each site is placed in its grid region, of 23 total in the study, with a regional average mix from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). These are then multiplied and added up for the total number. Such estimation methods may reduce the strength of arguments against data center buildouts.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The power is also not evenly laid out, with 142 of the sites located in Virginia alone, taking 21.4 TWh, or about a quarter. PJM, a grid operator for 13 states, including Virginia, and D.C., or America’s largest grid, covers 32.8 TWh, or about 40%, more than any other region. Notably for Virginia, its power draw is actually just a bit below the 22.85 TWh estimate for all U.S. hyperscale sites from 2018. See the table for more details. Swipe to scroll horizontally Top 10 states by CO2 attributed to hyperscale data centers State Sites Electricity (TWh) CO2 (million metric tons) CO2 per kWh (g) Virginia 142 21.4 7.0 325 Iowa 26 7.2 3.2 445 Ohio 38 8.8 2.9 325 Texas 22 4.6 1.5 333 Nebraska 8 3.5 1.4 395 Oregon 56 11.1 1.3 119 Arizona 12 3.2 1.3 401 Oklahoma 8 2.9 1.1 395 Wyoming 2 1.2 1.0 848 Utah 5 1.3 0.8 640 Not all power is equal — renewables, for example, can be perceived more favorably — and 53.9% of the estimated draw comes from fossil fuels, 38.2% of the total from gas and 15.2% from coal. Renewables cover 25.3% while nuclear handles the remaining 20.9%. Estimates put this in the 21–31 Mt range for CO2 output, versus the 10.5 Mt estimate from 2018. You may like US AI data centers projected to become the fifth-largest natural gas consumer in the world by 2035 US data centers could wipe out 15 years' worth of progress in greenhouse gas emissions, report claims 'America hates data centers' — New data highlights public sentiment Estimated fuel mix of the electricity attributed to 403 U.S. hyperscale data centers (“US Total”) and to the seven grid regions with the most data center load. (Image credit: Guidi et al. / arXiv (CC BY 4.0))Estimated carbon intensity, though, is lower than the average, at 314 g of CO2 per kWh versus 348 for the entire U.S. grid, or about 10% lower. Admittedly, almost a quarter of the load is in regions dirtier than the U.S. average. The likely reason it’s lower is that the biggest loads lie in PJM territory, which is nuclear-heavy, while Oregon, for its part, is hydro-heavy. The estimates, in this case, use 2023 plant data, and the method does not trace which plant feeds which site and also leaves out clean-power contracts and credits.The study’s results also lag reality as the window ended in April 2025 and, with how much development there has been for AI, among other things, the footprint “could already be substantially larger now in 2026,” lead author Gianluca Guidi said in a statement. Another issue is that the median site capacity in the study is relatively small compared to upcoming buildouts, with many campuses now planned in the hundreds or thousands of megawatts. On-site power, such as gas plants, also may not show up in grid data.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsOfficial numbers may be forthcoming, though, as the Energy Information Administration’s pilot surveys of data center energy use are complete, and the agency is using them to design a survey of the sector, a spokesperson told Wired. The first pilots, which launched in March, relied on web surveys and in-person interviews, with 196 companies asked about energy sources, electricity use, plus servers and cooling, although not covering all states. Gauging the direct human impact is next in the chain, with Francesca Dominici, the study’s corresponding author, saying that quantifying health effects is an important next step. history.titleZh: 美国403座超大规模数据中心一年耗电高达82太瓦，超过密歇根州总用电量的80%
history.descriptionZh:
哈佛大学牵头的一项研究对美国超大规模数据中心能耗进行了设施级估算：403个已确认的超大规模数据中心站点全年用电约82 TWh，约占美国全国总用电量的1.8%；其中超过一半电力来自天然气和煤炭。作为对比，密歇根州2024年全年售电量约为99 TWh。研究还估算这些站点一年排放约2570万吨二氧化碳，是2018年类似估算的2至3倍。该研究由Wired报道，第一作者为Gianluca Guidi，通讯作者为Francesca Dominici，相关估算发布在arXiv上，属于对AI算力基础设施扩张背景下数据中心能源与环境影响的量化尝试。

研究中的“超大规模数据中心”指由超大规模云服务商或内容提供商运营的站点，或为这类客户提供服务的托管运营商站点，单站容量通常在数十兆瓦级。研究团队从数据供应商Baxtel获得675个候选站点，并通过卫星图像和建筑足迹地图确认其中403个，平均容量39.9 MW，中位容量36 MW。由于美国没有官方逐站统计数据中心实际从电网取电，研究采用自下而上的估算方法：将每个站点的最大容量乘以全年小时数，再乘以对数据中心运行强度的估计，得到用电量；随后把每个站点归入23个电网区域之一，使用美国环保署（EPA）提供的区域平均电源结构计算排放和电力来源，再逐站汇总。其方法创新主要在于设施级、站点级的细化估算，以及将站点位置与区域电网电源结构匹配，从而给出州和区域层面的用电与排放分布。

从结果看，数据中心负荷高度集中。弗吉尼亚州单独拥有142个站点，用电21.4 TWh，约占全部估算用电的四分之一；覆盖包括弗吉尼亚州和华盛顿特区在内13个州的PJM电网区域承担32.8 TWh，约占40%，是美国最大的数据中心负荷区域。弗吉尼亚州的用电量甚至略低于2018年研究对全美超大规模数据中心22.85 TWh的估算。排放方面，弗吉尼亚州 attributed CO2约700万吨，爱荷华州约320万吨，俄亥俄州约290万吨，得克萨斯州约150万吨，内布拉斯加州约140万吨，俄勒冈州约130万吨，亚利桑那州约130万吨，俄克拉荷马州约110万吨，怀俄明州约100万吨，犹他州约80万吨。电源结构上，估算总用电中化石燃料占53.9%，其中天然气38.2%、煤炭15.2%；可再生能源占25.3%，核能占20.9%。二氧化碳排放估算区间为2100万至3100万吨，而2018年估算为1050万吨。

值得注意的是，这些超大规模数据中心的估算碳强度为每千瓦时314克二氧化碳，低于美国全国电网平均的348克/千瓦时，约低10%。研究认为，原因之一是最大负荷集中在核能占比较高的PJM区域，而俄勒冈州水电占比较高；但仍有近四分之一负荷位于碳强度高于美国平均水平的区域。该估算使用2023年电厂数据，但不追踪具体哪座电厂为哪个站点供电，也未计入清洁电力采购合同和可再生能源信用，因此结果存在方法论局限。研究时间窗口截至2025年4月，考虑到AI数据中心建设速度，第一作者表示到2026年实际 footprint“可能已经大幅增加”。此外，研究中位站点容量相对当前规划中的数百兆瓦甚至数千兆瓦园区偏小，现场发电（如天然气发电）也可能不体现在电网数据中。

这项研究的现实影响在于，它为AI数据中心扩张引发的电网压力、碳排放核算和公众舆论争议提供了更细颗粒度的基线数据；但其估算方法也可能被用于削弱反对数据中心建设的论据，因为数据并非官方实测。美国能源信息署（EIA）已完成数据中心能源使用试点调查，并正据此设计行业调查；2025年3月启动的试点通过网页问卷和面对面访谈，向196家公司询问能源来源、用电、服务器和冷却等情况，但未覆盖所有州。研究团队下一步将量化数据中心对人群健康的直接影响。总体来看，该研究揭示了美国超大规模数据中心用电和排放的规模、区域集中度及电源结构特征，也凸显了在AI推动数据中心快速扩张背景下，建立官方、透明、可核验能耗统计体系的紧迫性。
